name: Son Goku
visual_anchor: Cinematic vertical 9:16 portrait of Son Goku in his torn orange martial arts gi, spiked golden Super Saiyan hair crackling with bio-electric blue lightning and brilliant golden aura on a rocky battlefield.
core_traits: Saiyan warrior sent from planet Vegeta to Earth as an infant, raised by Grandpa Gohan
Endlessly cheerful martial artist dedicated to testing his limits against the strongest beings in the universe
Trained under Master Roshi, King Kai, and Whis to master divine techniques like the Kaio-ken and Ultra Instinct
Iconic signature finishing technique is the blue energy wave known as the Kamehameha

facts_and_myths.claim: Goku's birth name on planet Vegeta was Kakarot, named after the root vegetable carrot.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Dragon Ball creator Akira Toriyama based all Saiyan names on vegetable puns, such as Kakarot from carrot, Vegeta from vegetable, and Raditz from radish.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Goku's adoptive Earth grandfather named him Son Goku after the legendary Monkey King Sun Wukong from Journey to the West.

facts_and_myths.claim: Super Saiyan hair was designed golden to signify royal Saiyan blood and celestial divinity.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Akira Toriyama chose to make Super Saiyan hair blonde and uncolored to save his assistant from spending hours laboriously inking Goku's black hair with black ink in the weekly manga.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Toriyama famously remarked that coloring Goku's spiky black hair was the most time-consuming step in illustrating the manga.

name: Monkey D. Luffy
visual_anchor: Heroic 9:16 vertical action shot of Monkey D. Luffy wearing his weathered straw hat and red open vest, arm stretched backward in a devastating rubber punch glowing with black Conqueror Haki lightning sparks over an ocean storm.
core_traits: Captain and founder of the Straw Hat Pirates dreaming of discovering the ultimate treasure to become King of the Pirates
Gained a rubber body after inadvertently consuming the legendary Gum-Gum Devil Fruit as a young boy
Known for an insatiable appetite for meat, fierce loyalty to his crewmates, and fearless instinctual combat skills
Ascends into Gear 5 awakening, channeling the mythical freedom-loving Sun God Nika with cartoonish reality-warping physics

facts_and_myths.claim: Luffy's iconic straw hat originally belonged to the former Pirate King Gol D. Roger.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Gol D. Roger wore the straw hat in his youth before passing it to Red-Haired Shanks, who later entrusted it to Luffy as a promise to meet again on the Grand Line.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: The straw hat is considered Luffy's most treasured possession, and he almost never allows anyone else to touch it.

facts_and_myths.claim: Luffy's Devil Fruit was always intended to be a simple paramecia rubber fruit with no deeper mythical origin.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Author Eiichiro Oda planted hints about the Sun God Nika and drums of liberation throughout the Skypiea and Fish-Man Island arcs long before formally revealing the fruit as the Mythical Zoan Model: Nika.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Luffy's signature attack Gum-Gum Pistol was inspired by Oda's desire to give the hero the goofiest, most elastic power possible.

name: Naruto Uzumaki
visual_anchor: Cinematic 9:16 vertical composition of Naruto Uzumaki enveloped in glowing orange Nine-Tails Chakra Mode, spiraling a blazing cyan Rasengan in his palm while floating above the ruins of the Leaf Village.
core_traits: Orphaned shinobi shunned by the Hidden Leaf Village for harboring the Nine-Tails beast Kurama sealed inside his body
Driven by an unwavering ninja way to never give up and an ambitious dream to become Hokage to earn villagers' respect
Mastered the Shadow Clone Technique, Sage Mode nature energy, and legendary Rasengan sphere under master Jiraiya
Befriended all tailed beasts and brought peace to the shinobi world by rescuing his best friend Sasuke from darkness

facts_and_myths.claim: Naruto's favorite ramen shop, Ramen Ichiraku, was inspired by a real noodle shop near creator Masashi Kishimoto's university.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Masashi Kishimoto frequently visited a real ramen shop named Ichiraku in Kyushu while attending university, later immortalizing it in the manga.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: The name Naruto itself is also the word for a type of spiral fish cake commonly used as a topping in traditional Japanese ramen bowls.

facts_and_myths.claim: Naruto was originally conceptualized as a modern teen ninja training in a martial arts high school.
facts_and_myths.explanation: In Kishimoto's 1997 one-shot pilot manga, Naruto was not a ninja at all, but rather a nine-tailed fox demon disguised as a young human boy in modern Tokyo.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: The editor advised Kishimoto to change the setting and make Naruto a human ninja apprentice to make the story more relatable.

name: Ichigo Kurosaki
visual_anchor: Dynamic 9:16 vertical frame of orange-haired Ichigo Kurosaki in black shihakusho robes wielding his oversized cleaver Zanpakuto Zangetsu, dark spiritual pressure swirls creating a menacing Hollow mask over half his face.
core_traits: High school student who possessed the rare spiritual gift to see ghosts and wandering spirits since childhood
Became a Substitute Soul Reaper after receiving the spiritual powers of Rukia Kuchiki to protect his family
Discovered a complex hybrid lineage combining Shinigami, Quincy, and inner Hollow spiritual energies
Unleashes the swift black-bladed Bankai Tensa Zangetsu and the destructive Getsuga Tensho energy slash

facts_and_myths.claim: Ichigo's bright orange hair made him a frequent target for neighborhood bullies during his school years.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Because natural orange hair is exceedingly rare in Japan, classmates and street thugs constantly accused him of dyeing it, prompting him to learn martial arts to defend himself.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: The name Ichigo can mean strawberry or first prize, but his father explained it means one who protects.

facts_and_myths.claim: The mysterious bearded old man Zangetsu in Ichigo's inner world was always the true spirit of his Soul Reaper sword.
facts_and_myths.explanation: The old man was actually the manifestation of Ichigo's Quincy heritage in the image of Yhwach, who suppressed his true Soul Reaper power, which was actually his inner White Hollow.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Creator Tite Kubo foreshadowed this twist hundreds of chapters earlier by having the Hollow constantly declare 'I am Zangetsu!'

name: Gon Freecss
visual_anchor: Intense 9:16 vertical composition of spiky dark-green-haired Gon Freecss in green shorts and jacket, golden Nen aura swirling fiercely around his fist as he charges up his devastating Jajanken Rock punch.
core_traits: Pure-hearted, athletic boy raised on Whale Island who leaves home to become a licensed Hunter and track down his absentee father Ging
Possesses heightened animal-like senses, superhuman stamina, and an uncompromising, morally ambiguous determination
Natural Enhancer Nen user who developed the versatile Jajanken technique based on the game of Rock-Paper-Scissors
Sacrificed all his future Nen potential in a grim vow to obtain overwhelming adult physical form and avenge his mentor Kite

facts_and_myths.claim: Gon uses his father's old fishing rod as an unconventional weapon and grappling tool in early arcs.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Gon trained on Whale Island catching the giant Master of the Swamp with Ging's rod, then wielded it skillfully during the Hunter Exam and early Heaven's Arena matches.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Gon's keen sense of smell is sharp enough to detect impending rainstorms hours before clouds gather.

facts_and_myths.claim: Gon is permanently incapable of ever using Nen again after surviving his devastating covenant against Pitou.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Ging later explains to Gon that Nanika's wish restored Gon to a normal human state, meaning his aura nodes are closed like a regular person rather than destroyed, allowing him to relearn Nen if he chooses.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Gon returned to Whale Island to catch up on regular school homework after being healed.

name: Vegeta
visual_anchor: Dramatic 9:16 vertical frame of Prince Vegeta in dark blue combat bodysuit and white Saiyan chest armor, arms crossed proudly with a defiant smirk as purple Ultra Ego aura erupts around his body amidst shattered boulders.
core_traits: Proud crown prince of the fallen Saiyan race who arrived on Earth as an antagonist seeking the Dragon Balls
Grew from a ruthless conqueror into a devoted Earth protector, family man, and eternal rival to Goku
Renowned for ferocious combat tenacity, tactical genius, and unwillingness to let anyone insult his Saiyan royal pride
Mastered devastating energy bombardments including Galick Gun, Big Bang Attack, and Final Flash

facts_and_myths.claim: Vegeta was originally slated to be killed off permanently during the Saiyan Saga battle on Earth.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Akira Toriyama intended for Vegeta to be a one-arc villain, but overwhelming positive fan reactions persuaded Toriyama and his editors to spare him and bring him back on Planet Namek.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Toriyama once admitted in an interview that he did not personally like Vegeta at first, yet found him extremely useful for driving dramatic tension.

facts_and_myths.claim: Vegeta has never achieved a solo victory against a major saga final villain in the Dragon Ball Z manga.
facts_and_myths.explanation: While Goku or Gohan defeated Frieza, Cell, and Kid Buu, Vegeta eliminated nearly all of Frieza's top command structure on Namek, including Cui, Dodoria, Zarbon, and Ginyu Force members.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Vegeta holds the canon record for eliminating the most members of Frieza's elite army on Namek.

name: Roronoa Zoro
visual_anchor: Atmospheric 9:16 vertical portrait of green-haired Roronoa Zoro clad in a dark green coat, clenching the white Wado Ichimonji sword in his teeth while two black-coated katana unleash dragon-shaped slashes of green aura.
core_traits: Former bounty hunter who became the first crew member and combatant of Monkey D. Luffy's Straw Hat Pirates
Swore a childhood oath to his deceased friend Kuina to become the greatest swordsman in the world
Legendary practitioner of Santoryu (Three-Sword Style), famously fighting with one blade held firmly in his mouth
Possesses immense physical tolerance and Conqueror Haki, but suffers from a comical and total lack of directional sense

facts_and_myths.claim: Roronoa Zoro was originally planned by Eiichiro Oda to be a bodyguard for the villainous pirate Buggy the Clown.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Early concept art sketches released in One Piece volume 3 show Zoro designed as the eldest henchman in Buggy's pirate crew before Oda decided to make him Luffy's first recruit.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Zoro's surname Roronoa is the Japanese phonetic rendition of the real-life 17th-century French pirate Francois l'Olonnais.

facts_and_myths.claim: Zoro permanently lost his left eye during a secret duel to the death against Dracule Mihawk over the timeskip.
facts_and_myths.explanation: The manga and anime have never revealed any duel or battle causing Zoro's scar; Oda has kept the exact origin of his closed eye an unconfirmed mystery, debunking popular fan rumors.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Eiichiro Oda decided Zoro would have an eye scar as far back as 1997 when conceptualizing the series' mid-point changes.

name: Sasuke Uchiha
visual_anchor: Intense 9:16 vertical depiction of Sasuke Uchiha with glowing crimson Mangekyo Sharingan in his right eye and purple Rinnegan in his left, channeling crackling blue Chidori lightning along his Kusanagi blade under dark stormy skies.
core_traits: Sole survivor of the tragic Uchiha clan massacre carried out by his older brother Itachi in the Hidden Leaf Village
Genin prodigy of Team 7 alongside Naruto Uzumaki and Sakura Haruno, driven by deep vengeance that led him into exile
Awakened the supreme visual prowess of the Sharingan, Mangekyo Sharingan, and six-tomoe Rinnegan
Specializes in lightning-nature Chidori techniques, black inextinguishable Amaterasu flames, and the colossal Susanoo avatar

facts_and_myths.claim: Masashi Kishimoto initially had not planned to create Sasuke until an editor suggested Naruto needed a proper rival.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Kishimoto's editor Kosuke Yahagi noted that Shonen Jump protagonist stories thrive on intense rivalry, prompting Kishimoto to design Sasuke as Naruto's polar opposite.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Kishimoto found Sasuke the most difficult character to draw due to his sharp, handsome facial contours and spiky hair.

facts_and_myths.claim: Sasuke took his older brother Itachi's eyes solely to gain ultimate destructive power to destroy the Leaf Village.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Sasuke only transplanted Itachi's eyes to acquire the Eternal Mangekyo Sharingan because his own eyesight was going completely blind from overuse after battling Danzo and the Five Kage.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: The design of Sasuke's Eternal Mangekyo Sharingan visually combines his own straight-six-point star with Itachi's pinwheel pattern.

name: Kakashi Hatake
visual_anchor: Stylized 9:16 vertical visual of silver-haired Kakashi Hatake wearing his navy Leaf Village flak jacket and forehead protector tilted over one eye, reading his orange Make-Out Paradise book while blue Chidori sparks dance across his fingers.
core_traits: Prodigious shinobi who graduated the Ninja Academy at age five and became an elite Anbu black ops captain in his youth
Beloved mentor and squad leader of Team 7 (Naruto, Sasuke, and Sakura), instilling the core lesson that those who abandon comrades are scum
Famously known across nations as the Copy Ninja after copying over a thousand jutsu using a transplanted Sharingan eye
Creator of the high-concentration lightning assassination technique known as Chidori or Lightning Blade (Raikiri)

facts_and_myths.claim: Kakashi's habit of consistently arriving late with ridiculous excuses was inherited directly from his fallen teammate Obito Uchiha.
facts_and_myths.explanation: As a boy Kakashi was strictly punctual, but after Obito sacrificed himself, Kakashi adopted Obito's chronic tardiness and habit of visiting the Memorial Stone every morning.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: His famous excuse 'I got lost on the path of life' was a direct homage to Obito's lighthearted demeanor.

facts_and_myths.claim: Kakashi keeps his lower face masked because he hides a grotesque scar or monstrous facial defect underneath.
facts_and_myths.explanation: When Kakashi's face was finally unveiled in a special chapter and anime episode, he was revealed to be conventionally handsome with a tiny beauty mark on his chin.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: He originally wore a mask in childhood simply because his father Sakumo made him wear one to stay discreet as a ninja.

name: Killua Zoldyck
visual_anchor: Electrifying 9:16 vertical dynamic frame of silver-haired Killua Zoldyck in casual loose t-shirt, his eyes flashing ruthless intensity as white-hot electric lightning crackles from his fingertips in Godspeed mode across a neon-lit urban alleyway.
core_traits: Prodigious heir to the notorious Zoldyck family of elite assassins who ran away from home to take the Hunter Exam for fun
Endured brutal torture and poison training since infancy, developing total immunity to poisons and electricity
Forms an unbreakable bond of friendship with Gon Freecss, gradually overcoming his conditioned assassin fears to protect others
Transmutes his Nen aura into electricity, mastering superhuman reflexes through Whirlwind and Speed of Lightning techniques

facts_and_myths.claim: Killua's custom twin yo-yos weigh fifty kilograms each and are made of a special durable alloy that conducts electricity.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Killua introduced his twin yo-yos during the Greed Island arc, using their combined 100-kilogram mass as devastating blunt-force weapons channeled with electric Nen.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Killua spent hundreds of thousands of Jenny buying sweets and chocolate robot balls during his early travels.

facts_and_myths.claim: Killua's subconscious urge to flee from stronger opponents was purely an inherent character flaw and lack of courage.
facts_and_myths.explanation: His instinct to run was artificially planted into his brain by his older brother Illumi using a mind-controlling Nen needle to ensure the family heir's survival.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Once Killua discovered and physically pulled Illumi's needle out of his forehead, his psychological limitations vanished completely.

name: Edward Elric
visual_anchor: A determined young blonde alchemist with a braided ponytail and red hooded coat, clapping his metal automail hands together as brilliant blue alchemy sparks illuminate his metallic arm in vertical portrait framing.
core_traits: Youngest State Alchemist in Amestris military history, earning his certification at the age of twelve
Performs alchemy without drawing a transmutation circle after witnessing the Truth behind the Gate
Travels across the continent searching for the Philosopher's Stone to restore his and his brother Alphonse's bodies
Notoriously sensitive and explosive whenever anyone makes remarks about his short stature

facts_and_myths.claim: Edward Elric sacrificed his right arm to bind his brother Alphonse's soul to an empty suit of armor.
facts_and_myths.explanation: After human transmutation rebounded and cost Edward his left leg and Alphonse his entire body, Edward gave up his right arm to anchor Alphonse's soul.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Edward's automail limbs were custom-engineered and maintained by his childhood mechanic friend Winry Rockbell.

facts_and_myths.claim: Edward Elric earned the military title Fullmetal Alchemist because his automail limbs are made of metal.
facts_and_myths.explanation: King Bradley gave him the codename ironically due to his stubborn, unyielding personality rather than his metal limbs.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Edward hates drinking milk so much that he blames it for his slow physical growth.

name: Yusuke Urameshi
visual_anchor: A tough Japanese teenage delinquent with slicked-back dark green hair and green uniform jacket pointing his index finger forward as glowing blue Spirit Gun energy charges at the fingertip in dynamic vertical perspective.
core_traits: Streetwise teenage delinquent who dies saving a child from oncoming traffic, surprising the Underworld
Appointed as the Spirit Detective of the Human World by Prince Koenma of Spirit Realm
Channels raw spiritual energy into his signature index finger projectile attack known as the Spirit Gun
Discovers late in the series that he possesses demonic ancestry descended from the ancient Mazoku king Raizen

facts_and_myths.claim: Yusuke was initially not supposed to die on the day he was hit by a speeding car.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Koenma reveals that the child Yusuke pushed out of the way would have miraculously survived the crash unharmed anyway, leaving the Spirit Realm unprepared for Yusuke's sudden demise.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Botan acted as Yusuke's cheerful guide through the River Sanzu and the afterlife.

facts_and_myths.claim: Yusuke Urameshi won the championship tournament of the Demon Realm World at the end of the series.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Yusuke was eliminated in the Demon Realm Tournament by Yomi in an exhausting battle, and the tournament was ultimately won by Enki.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Creator Yoshihiro Togashi later married Naoko Takeuchi, the creator of Sailor Moon.

name: Kenshiro
visual_anchor: A towering muscular martial artist with seven constellation scars across his chest walking through a dusty post-apocalyptic wasteland at sunset, leather vest torn open as his leather-gloved fists glow with lethal internal martial power.
core_traits: The 64th grandmaster and chosen sole successor of the deadly assassination martial art Hokuto Shinken
Bears seven distinctive scars arranged in the shape of the Big Dipper constellation on his muscular chest
Wanders a brutal post-nuclear wasteland fighting warlords to protect innocent survivors and search for his lost love Yuria
Famous for delivering the iconic death proclamation: You are already dead before enemies rupture from internal pressure points

facts_and_myths.claim: Kenshiro's visual design and persona were inspired by martial arts icon Bruce Lee and Hollywood action hero Mad Max.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Artist Tetsuo Hara combined the physical traits, screaming battle cries, and fighting style of Bruce Lee with the leather-clad apocalyptic aesthetic of Mel Gibson in Mad Max.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Kenshiro's iconic battle cry was directly modeled after Bruce Lee's high-pitched martial arts yells.

facts_and_myths.claim: Hokuto Shinken techniques used by Kenshiro can only be used to violently explode enemies and cannot heal wounds.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Hokuto Shinken targets 708 hidden meridian points, known as keiraku hiko, which can also be pressed to heal diseases, restore lost eyesight, or numb severe pain.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Kenshiro once cured a girl named Rin from traumatic muteness by gently pressing pressure points on her neck.

name: Kenshin Himura
visual_anchor: A slender red-haired wandering swordsman with a cross-shaped scar on his left cheek gripping the hilt of a reverse-blade katana beneath falling cherry blossom petals in vertical cinematic composition.
core_traits: Legendary former assassin of the Bakumatsu revolution feared throughout Japan as the Hitokiri Battosai
Carries a reverse-blade sword called the Sakabato to honor a sacred vow never to take another human life
Master of the lightning-fast Hiten Mitsurugi-ryu battoujutsu swordsmanship style taught by master Hiko Seijuro
Recognized by his long fiery red ponytail and prominent cross-shaped scar etched onto his left cheek

facts_and_myths.claim: Kenshin Himura was not born with the name Kenshin; his original birth name was Shinta.
facts_and_myths.explanation: His sword master Hiko Seijuro XIII renamed him Kenshin, explaining that Shinta was too gentle a name for a swordsman.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Kenshin frequently punctuates his speech with the humble verbal tic 'oro' when startled or confused.

facts_and_myths.claim: The cross-shaped scar on Kenshin's cheek was given to him by his main rival Makoto Shishio in a single sword clash.
facts_and_myths.explanation: The two intersecting cuts were made by two separate people: the first by Kiyosato Akira and the second by Akira's fiancee Yukishiro Tomoe.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Author Nobuhiro Watsuki based Kenshin's assassin persona on historical samurai Kawakami Gensai.

name: Jotaro Kujo
visual_anchor: A stoic towering Japanese student in a modified dark school uniform with a gold-chained collar and cap blending into his dark hair, summoning a muscular purple-and-cyan ghostly Stand warrior in a vertical street confrontation.
core_traits: The third generational protagonist of the JoJo lineage, traveling to Egypt to defeat the vampire Dio Brando
Wields the immensely powerful close-range Stand Star Platinum, known for superhuman speed, strength, and precision
Discovers during his climactic showdown against Dio that Star Platinum possesses the secret ability to stop time
Distinctive appearance featuring a modified school uniform cap that seamlessly blends into the back of his hair

facts_and_myths.claim: In his adult life, Jotaro Kujo became a certified doctor of marine biology and authored a thesis on starfish.
facts_and_myths.explanation: After the events of Stardust Crusaders, Jotaro completed university studies and earned a doctorate in marine biology, publishing research on starfish in Japan.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: His trademark catchphrase 'Yare Yare Daze' translates roughly to 'Good grief' or 'Give me a break'.

facts_and_myths.claim: Jotaro Kujo was born with his Stand Star Platinum active since infancy.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Jotaro only awakened his Stand at age seventeen when the family arch-nemesis Dio Brando pierced his own body with the Stand Bow and Arrow.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Star Platinum was named after the seventeenth Major Arcana tarot card, The Star.

name: Guts
visual_anchor: A battle-scarred dark-haired warrior wearing jagged ebony armor wielding an enormous iron broadsword over his shoulder, a mechanical prosthetic cannon arm glinting as embers drift across a blood-red vertical night sky.
core_traits: Former mercenary commander of the Band of the Falcon who survived the catastrophic demonic ritual known as the Eclipse
Wields the Dragon Slayer, a gargantuan slab of forged iron far too heavy and thick for any ordinary human to lift
Carries a mechanical prosthetic left arm fitted with a concealed single-shot cannon and repeating magnetic crossbow
Marked with the Brand of Sacrifice on his neck, constantly attracting restless evil spirits and ferocious demons every night

facts_and_myths.claim: Guts was born directly from the corpse of his hanged mother beneath a hanging tree on a battlefield.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Mercenary leader Gambino's lover Shisu discovered the infant newborn crying in the mud underneath a hanged woman, adopting him into their mercenary camp.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Guts began training with adult-sized steel swords as a young boy because there were no child-sized weapons available in camp.

facts_and_myths.claim: Guts wielded the Dragon Slayer sword during his entire golden era service in the Band of the Falcon.
facts_and_myths.explanation: He used standard greatswords in the Band of the Falcon; he only received the Dragon Slayer from blacksmith Godo after surviving the Eclipse.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: The Skull Knight famously refers to Guts as 'The Struggler' who constantly defies causality and fate.

name: Saitama
visual_anchor: A bald superhero in a bright yellow jumpsuit with a flowing white cape and red rubber gloves standing amidst shattered concrete rubble against a stark vertical anime sky, displaying an utterly bored expression.
core_traits: Unemployed young man who became so overwhelmingly strong that he defeats every single adversary with just one casual punch
Suffers from severe existential boredom and emotional detachment because no battle provides him genuine excitement or danger
Claims his superhuman invulnerability resulted from a simple daily regime of 100 pushups, situps, squats, and a 10-kilometer run
Officially registered as a low-ranking professional hero in the Hero Association under the disrespectful hero alias Caped Baldy

facts_and_myths.claim: Saitama achieved his godlike strength by completely breaking his natural biological limiter through sheer willpower.
facts_and_myths.explanation: As explained by scientist Dr. Genus, Saitama surpassed the natural growth boundaries placed on living beings through unrelenting, life-threatening physical effort.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Saitama's greatest everyday concerns are supermarket bargain discount sales and missing garbage pickup days.

facts_and_myths.claim: Saitama scored the highest overall grade in Hero Association history on both the physical test and the written exam.
facts_and_myths.explanation: While Saitama shattered all physical records, he scored so poorly on the written exam that he was initially placed in the lowest C-Class tier.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: His cyborg disciple Genos takes meticulous notes on everything Saitama says, assuming hidden wisdom in trivial comments.

name: All Might
aliases: Eighth User of One For All
visual_anchor: A massive muscular superhero in a blue, red, and white patriotic costume with twin golden hair spikes raised upward, flashing a beaming fearless smile in a bright vertical city plaza surrounded by cheering citizens.
core_traits: The world's former Number One Pro Hero who stood as the unwavering Symbol of Peace for decades
The eighth wielder of the transferable stockpile Quirk known as One For All, passing it down to Izuku Midoriya
Conceals a severely weakened true form with sunken cheeks and hollow black eyes caused by catastrophic past lung damage
Famous for entering catastrophic disaster zones with his signature booming motto: 'I am here!'

facts_and_myths.claim: All Might was originally born completely Quirkless before receiving One For All from his mentor Nana Shimura.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Just like his chosen successor Izuku Midoriya, Toshinori Yagi had no natural genetic Quirk, which made his body an ideal vessel for One For All.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: All of All Might's signature smash attacks are named after American states and cities, such as Detroit Smash and United States of Smash.

facts_and_myths.claim: All Might's muscle form is an active transformation Quirk separate from the power of One For All.
facts_and_myths.explanation: His muscular physique was his original natural body built through years of training, which he flexes to maintain like a person holding in their stomach.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: All Might's distinctive costume design and aesthetic were inspired by American Golden Age comic superheroes like Superman.

name: Natsu Dragneel
visual_anchor: A spiky pink-haired teenage dragon slayer mage wearing a white dragon-scale scarf and sleeveless black vest, erupting in roaring golden flames from his fists and mouth in a vertical fantasy battlefield.
core_traits: Fierce Fire Dragon Slayer Mage of the Fairy Tail Guild who consumes external fire to replenish his magical stamina
Raised and taught ancient dragon slayer magic by the fire dragon king Igneel before Igneel mysteriously disappeared
Suffers from severe, debilitating motion sickness whenever boarding any form of transportation or moving vehicle
Revealed to be the resurrected younger brother of dark wizard Zeref and the ultimate demon book creation E.N.D.

facts_and_myths.claim: Natsu's signature white patterned scarf was made from the actual shed scales of his adoptive dragon father Igneel.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Igneel crafted the scarf out of his own protective dragon scales, giving Natsu a durable charm that even protected him against Zeref's death magic.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Natsu has a blue flying cat companion named Happy who carries him through the air without triggering his motion sickness.

facts_and_myths.claim: Natsu Dragneel can consume any fire including his own magical flames to restore his strength.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Dragon Slayers cannot eat flames generated from their own magic; they can only ingest external sources of fire created by enemies or the environment.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: The name Natsu is the Japanese word for summer, reflecting his fiery element and energetic personality.

name: Asta
visual_anchor: An athletic muscular teenage boy with wild ash-blond hair and a black headband swinging a massive rusted greatsword surrounded by crackling black anti-magic energy wings in dramatic vertical perspective.
core_traits: Orphan raised in the remote village of Hage who was born completely devoid of magical power in a world where magic is everything
Possesses a rare five-leaf clover grimoire inhabited by the devil Liebe, granting him the power of Anti-Magic
Compensated for his lack of magic with relentless physical conditioning, allowing him to wield massive anti-magic iron swords
Member of the rambunctious Black Bulls magic squad under Captain Yami Sukehiro, aiming to become the Wizard King

facts_and_myths.claim: Asta is the only person who can wield his swords because they passively drain the magical power of anyone who touches them.
facts_and_myths.explanation: The Demon-Slayer and Demon-Dweller swords absorb mana immediately upon contact, meaning any normal mage would have their magic drained instantly.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: The five leaves on Asta's grimoire represent faith, hope, love, good fortune, and inside the fifth leaf resides a devil.

facts_and_myths.claim: Asta was born without magic because his biological father was a demon from the Underworld.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Asta's mother Licita had a biological condition that continuously drained magic and life force from anyone nearby, which prevented Asta from developing mana in the womb.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Despite having no mana, Asta developed the ability to sense Ki (life energy) taught to him by his squad captain Yami.

name: Portgas D. Ace
visual_anchor: A muscular pirate with freckled cheeks standing shirtless in 9:16 vertical composition, orange cowboy hat adorned with smiling and frowning badges, blazing crimson flames erupting dynamically from his fists and shoulders against a smoky battlefield.
core_traits: Sworn older adoptive brother of Monkey D. Luffy and Sabo, raised in the Mt. Corvo bandit hideout
Second division commander of the Whitebeard Pirates who wields the Flame-Flame Fruit Logia powers
Biological son of the legendary Pirate King Gol D. Roger, taking his mother Portgas D. Rouge's surname
His execution at Marineford ignited the historic Summit War that reshaped the Great Pirate Era

facts_and_myths.claim: Portgas D. Ace was carried in his mother's womb for twenty months to protect him from the World Government.
facts_and_myths.explanation: His mother Portgas D. Rouge held her pregnancy for twenty months through sheer willpower to conceal his lineage from cipher pol investigators, tragically dying of exhaustion right after childbirth.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Eiichiro Oda originally intended to give Ace the codename 'Portgas D. Lang' before settling on Ace.

facts_and_myths.claim: Ace gained the Flame-Flame Fruit powers during his childhood while training with Luffy and Sabo.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Ace was completely powerless as a child and only consumed the Mera Mera no Mi years later after being shipwrecked on Sixis Island alongside Masked Deuce.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: The Sixis Island backstory was chronicled in detail in the official One Piece novel A.

name: Itachi Uchiha
visual_anchor: A brooding shinobi framed in 9:16 vertical framing perched atop a wooden telephone pole under a blood-red crescent moon, wearing a high-collared black Akatsuki cloak with red clouds as ethereal black crows dissolve from his glowing crimson Mangekyo Sharingan.
core_traits: Prodigious ninja from Konohagakure who unlocked the Sharingan at age eight and graduated the Academy in one year
Anbu captain who massacred his entire clan in a single night to prevent a catastrophic civil war
Spared only his younger brother Sasuke, deliberately playing the role of a villain to fuel Sasuke's strength
Master of high-level genjutsu, the inextinguishable black flames of Amaterasu, and the spectral Susanoo armor

facts_and_myths.claim: Itachi joined the covert Anbu Black Ops organization at the extraordinarily young age of eleven.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Recognized as a generational prodigy, Itachi entered Anbu at age eleven and was promoted to squad captain by age thirteen.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Itachi's favorite food was sweet dango, and he was known to visit the Leaf Village dango shop regularly.

facts_and_myths.claim: Itachi slaughtered the Uchiha clan out of unprovoked malice and pure hatred for his family.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Itachi acted under secret orders from Danzo Shimura and the Leaf Village elders to stop a planned Uchiha coup d'etat that would have triggered a devastating Fourth Great Ninja War.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: He negotiated a secret deal with Third Hokage Hiruzen Sarutobi to ensure Sasuke's absolute safety.

name: Piccolo
visual_anchor: Tall green-skinned Namekian warrior standing resolute in 9:16 vertical perspective, wearing a weighted white turban and heavy flowing cape over a purple martial arts gi, pointed ears and antennas twitching as purple Special Beam Cannon energy crackles around his extended fingers.
core_traits: Green-skinned Namekian warrior born as the reincarnation and final son of King Piccolo to avenge his defeat against Goku
Reformed from a ruthless nemesis into one of Earth's greatest protectors and an irreplaceable Z Fighter strategist
Acted as a strict yet loving mentor and father figure to Son Gohan following Goku's death against Raditz
Signature finishing attack is the piercing spiral energy beam known as the Special Beam Cannon or Makankosappo

facts_and_myths.claim: Piccolo is only four years older than his surrogate student Son Gohan.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Because Namekians age and mature into adulthood in just three to four years, Piccolo was only eight years old when he trained four-year-old Gohan.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Piccolo hatched from an egg spat out by King Piccolo during his dying moments in original Dragon Ball.

facts_and_myths.claim: Piccolo requires regular meals of meat and vegetables like humans and Saiyans to survive.
facts_and_myths.explanation: As a Namekian, Piccolo's biology is purely autotrophic and requires only water for sustenance, though he can ingest food if he chooses.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Akira Toriyama frequently stated that Piccolo was his personal favorite character in the Dragon Ball franchise.

name: Roy Mustang
visual_anchor: A sharp Amestrian military officer in 9:16 vertical composition wearing an indigo uniform with gold trim, snapping his white pyrotechnic-glove-clad fingers as roaring streams of intense orange and yellow alchemy flames engulf the foreground.
core_traits: State Alchemist and ambitious military colonel in the Amestrian State Military aiming to become the next Fuhrer
Employs custom ignition cloth gloves engraved with transmutation circles to spark fires and direct oxygen concentrations
Haunted by the atrocities he committed during the Ishval Civil War, dedicating his career to establishing a democracy
Relies heavily on his fiercely loyal inner circle, most notably his sharpshooting subordinate Riza Hawkeye

facts_and_myths.claim: Roy Mustang becomes completely helpless in heavy rain because damp ignition cloth cannot create a spark.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Water saturates his spark-producing ignition gloves and prevents him from creating the friction spark needed to ignite oxygen, rendering him virtually useless on rainy days.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Subordinates humorously tease him by bluntly stating that he is useless when it rains.

facts_and_myths.claim: Mustang transmutes plain air into real fire using raw alchemy energy alone.
facts_and_myths.explanation: He does not create fire from nothing; his transmutation adjusts atmospheric oxygen density into a combustible path, which is then lit by a physical spark from his glove.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Mustang learned Flame Alchemy secrets from Berthold Hawkeye, who tattooed the research formula on his daughter Riza's back.

name: Kurapika
visual_anchor: A blonde youth in 9:16 vertical portrait composition wearing a blue and yellow traditional tabard, his eyes glowing iridescent crimson with Nen aura, metallic chains wrapped intricately around each finger of his right hand extending forward dramatically.
core_traits: Sole survivor of the massacred Kurta Clan, seeking vengeance against the Phantom Troupe who slaughtered his people for their eyes
Conjurer who manifests specialized chains on his right hand, each finger dedicated to a distinct tactical ability
When his eyes turn scarlet, his Nen type shifts from Conjuration to Specialist through Emperor Time, mastering all Nen affinities
Sacrifices an hour of his own lifespan for every single second he maintains Emperor Time activation

facts_and_myths.claim: Kurapika placed a Nen blade around his own heart to enforce a fatal vow on his Chain Jail ability.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Using Judgment Chain, Kurapika set a condition that if he ever uses Chain Jail on anyone who is not a member of the Phantom Troupe, the chain will instantly pierce his own heart and kill him.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: This extreme restriction grants Chain Jail near-unbreakable strength against the Spiders.

facts_and_myths.claim: Kurapika is unable to use healing Nen because he is purely a Conjurer.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Under Emperor Time, his affinity in Enhancement reaches 100 percent, allowing his Holy Chain on his thumb to instantly mend broken bones and heal critical wounds.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Kurapika passed the Hunter Exam alongside Gon, Killua, and Leorio on his very first attempt.

name: Hisoka Morow
visual_anchor: Flamboyant jester-themed transmuter standing tall in 9:16 vertical view, swept-back magenta hair, teardrop and star face paint, holding razor-sharp glowing playing cards between his fingertips surrounded by sticky pink Bungee Gum strands.
core_traits: Enigmatic, bloodthirsty magician and former fake member number four of the infamous Phantom Troupe
Lives solely to find and battle exceptionally powerful opponents, often sparing promising rookies until they reach their peak
Transmutes his aura into Bungee Gum, an elastic and sticky substance possessing properties of both rubber and gum
Uses Texture Surprise to apply illusions onto flat surfaces, flawlessly replicating skin, cloth, or text

facts_and_myths.claim: Hisoka named both of his signature Nen abilities after beloved confectionery brands from his impoverished childhood.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Yoshihiro Togashi revealed that Hisoka named Bungee Gum after a cheap chewing gum brand he loved as a poor boy, and Texture Surprise after peel-off stickers found in snack packages.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Hisoka repeatedly recites the properties of Bungee Gum, stating it possesses the properties of both rubber and gum.

facts_and_myths.claim: Hisoka was genuinely loyal to Chrollo Lucilfer and the Phantom Troupe's collective goals.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Hisoka joined the Spider solely to get an opportunity to fight Chrollo one-on-one, even forging his spider back tattoo using Texture Surprise.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: After losing at Heaven's Arena, Hisoka revived his own corpse by commanding his Bungee Gum to massage his heart and lungs.

name: Dio Brando
visual_anchor: Arrogant blonde vampire posing extravagantly in 9:16 vertical aspect ratio, wearing a yellow jacket and green heart headband, golden aura radiating outward as his powerful muscular Stand The World manifests menacingly behind him during frozen time.
core_traits: Ambitious Victorian orphan who betrayed the Joestar family by donning the ancient Stone Mask to become an immortal vampire
Primary antagonist of Phantom Blood and Stardust Crusaders whose sinister influence spans across generations of the Joestar bloodline
Stole Jonathan Joestar's decapitated body at sea and survived over a century submerged in an iron coffin
Wields the close-range Stand The World, possessing devastating strength, speed, and the power to freeze time itself

facts_and_myths.claim: Dio's name means 'God' in Italian and was partly inspired by heavy metal musician Ronnie James Dio.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Creator Hirohiko Araki named him after the Italian word for God to emphasize his god complex, as well as rock icon Ronnie James Dio and actor Marlon Brando.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: His Stand The World also pays homage to the classic tarot deck arcana system.

facts_and_myths.claim: Dio was born with his time-stopping Stand ability The World already unlocked.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Dio spent decades as a pure vampire and only acquired The World after Enya the Hag pierced him with the mysterious Stand Arrow in Egypt.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: At the end of Stardust Crusaders, Dio can stop time for up to nine seconds after absorbing Joseph Joestar's blood.

name: Genos
visual_anchor: A sleek blonde cyborg warrior framed in 9:16 vertical orientation, black sclera and piercing golden irises, intricate mechanical arms glowing with superheated orange plasma cannons ready to unleash an Incinerate blast amidst urban ruins.
core_traits: Nineteen-year-old high-tech cyborg seeking vengeance against the Mad Cyborg that eradicated his family and hometown
Reconstructed and continuously upgraded with bleeding-edge robotic technology by the brilliant scientist Dr. Kuseno
S-Class Rank 14 hero in the Hero Association who fervently idolizes Saitama as his revered martial sensei
Known for overwhelming destructive firepower through core Incineration cannons, though frequently dismantled in battles

facts_and_myths.claim: Genos qualified directly into the prestigious S-Class hero tier upon taking the Hero Association entrance exam.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Genos achieved a perfect score of 100 points on both the written exam and physical fitness test, granting him immediate placement in the elite S-Class.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: In the very same exam session, Saitama shattered all physical records but scored low on the written portion, placing into C-Class.

facts_and_myths.claim: Genos is a pure robot built with synthetic artificial intelligence and zero organic biological tissue.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Genos is a true cyborg who retains his original living human brain and minimal organic tissue encased inside his modular cybernetic body.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Genos keeps an obsessively detailed written notebook recording every casual remark and eating habit of Saitama.

name: Inuyasha
aliases: Son of the Great Dog Demon
visual_anchor: White-haired dog half-demon captured in 9:16 vertical framing, fluffy white canine ears atop his head, wearing a fiery red Robe of the Fire-Rat, brandishing the massive fanged broadsword Tessaiga surrounded by golden wind vortexes.
core_traits: Feudal era dog half-demon born to the Great Dog Demon General Toga and a human noblewoman named Izayoi
Sealed to the Sacred Tree of Ages by priestess Kikyo with a sacred arrow for fifty years until awakened by Kagome Higurashi
Wields the mystical broadsword Tessaiga, forged from his father's fang to protect humans and slay one hundred demons in one strike
Subject to the Subjugation Beads necklace that forces him face-first into the ground whenever Kagome commands 'Sit!'

facts_and_myths.claim: Inuyasha completely loses his demonic powers and turns into a black-haired human during the night of the new moon.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Once a month during the dark of the new moon, Inuyasha's demon blood temporarily recedes, turning his hair black and rendering him physically mortal.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: His half-brother Sesshomaru despises Inuyasha because their father bequeathed the powerful Tessaiga to a half-demon instead of him.

facts_and_myths.claim: Inuyasha's red kimono is ordinary dyed silk that provides no physical protection in combat.
facts_and_myths.explanation: His garment is the legendary Robe of the Fire-Rat, woven from hair of the mythical fire rat, making it virtually indestructible and completely immune to fire.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Rumiko Takahashi modeled Inuyasha's energetic personality partly after a rambunctious pet dog.

name: Yoh Asakura
visual_anchor: A calm, easygoing teenager in 9:16 vertical view wearing orange headphones around his neck and an open school uniform, channeling a spectral samurai spirit into an antique sword to form a glowing oversized spirit blade Over Soul.
core_traits: Easygoing shaman prodigy from the illustrious Asakura family whose guiding life motto is 'everything will work out'
Bonded with the guardian spirit Amidamaru, a legendary 600-year-old samurai known as the Demon Killer
Integrates spirits into physical relics using the Over Soul technique, channeling Amidamaru into the heirloom sword Harusame
Twin brother and reincarnation counterpart of Hao Asakura, the supreme villain seeking to annihilate humanity

facts_and_myths.claim: Yoh Asakura is the identical twin brother of the primary antagonist Hao Asakura.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Hao reincarnated into the Asakura lineage as the firstborn of twin babies, while Yoh was born seconds later as his innocent twin brother.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: The Asakura elders planned to kill both babies at birth to stop Hao, but Hao burned his way out before they could slay him.

facts_and_myths.claim: Yoh desires to become Shaman King to gain absolute military dominion and control the world.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Yoh's sole personal ambition for winning the Shaman Fight and attaining the Great Spirit is to create a peaceful world where he can live a totally carefree, easy life and listen to Bob music.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Yoh is constantly wearing his signature orange headphones because he loves listening to music by his favorite musician Bob.

name: Shanks
visual_anchor: Cinematic 9:16 vertical shot of red-haired pirate captain Shanks standing on the deck of the Red Force, black cape billowing in the ocean wind, three distinct claw scars across his left eye, one empty sleeve swaying, gripping the saber Gryphon with golden sunset highlights.
core_traits: Legendary Yonko and chief of the Red Hair Pirates who originally inspired Monkey D. Luffy to become a pirate
Sacrificed his left arm to a Sea King monster in the East Blue while saving a young Luffy from drowning
Former apprentice on the Oro Jackson alongside Buggy the Clown under Pirate King Gol D. Roger
Wields supreme Conqueror Haki and the famous meito saber named Gryphon despite lacking any Devil Fruit powers

facts_and_myths.claim: Shanks was discovered as an infant inside a treasure chest by Gol D. Roger after the God Valley Incident.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Eiichiro Oda revealed in Volume 4 Billion and Film Red backstory notes that the Roger Pirates found one-year-old Shanks inside a looted chest at God Valley.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Shanks is tied to the noble Saint Figarland bloodline of the World Nobles.

facts_and_myths.claim: Shanks ate a mythical Zoan Devil Fruit that allows him to control sea currents and ocean tides.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Shanks possesses no Devil Fruit abilities whatsoever, relying purely on peerless swordsmanship and master-level mastery of all three types of Haki.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: His arrival at Marineford single-handedly brought the Paramount War to an immediate halt without throwing a single punch.

name: Jiraiya
visual_anchor: Dramatic vertical 9:16 anime portrait of Jiraiya posing atop a colossal summoned toad, long spiky white mane fluttering, wearing a green kimono and red haori with wooden geta, distinctive facial red makeup stripes running down his cheeks beneath stormy rain.
core_traits: Renowned Legendary Sannin of the Hidden Leaf Village trained directly by the Third Hokage Hiruzen Sarutobi
Revered mentor and godfather to Naruto Uzumaki who taught him the Rasengan and toad summoning techniques
Eccentric wandering novelist who authored the Icha Icha romance book series loved by Kakashi Hatake
Infiltrated the Rain Village alone and fought heroically to the death against the Six Paths of Pain

facts_and_myths.claim: Jiraiya was repeatedly offered the mantle of Hokage of the Hidden Leaf Village but turned it down every time.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Following the deaths of both the Fourth and Third Hokage, the village council pleaded with Jiraiya to become Fifth Hokage, but he declined to search for Tsunade instead.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: He encoded his dying message about Pain's secret identity onto the back of the toad Fukasaku.

facts_and_myths.claim: Jiraiya achieved complete mastery over Sage Mode without undergoing any physical toad-like mutations.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Jiraiya never fully mastered Sage Mode on his own, which caused his nose to enlarge, warts to sprout, and toad eyes to manifest when channeling senjutsu.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: His imperfect Sage Mode required summoning elder toads Shima and Fukasaku to sit on his shoulders to gather natural energy.

name: Hiei
visual_anchor: Dynamic 9:16 vertical composition of dark demon swordsman Hiei unleashing the Dragon of the Darkness Flame, black ethereal fire swirling around his upraised right arm, unbinding forehead wraps revealing a glowing green Jagan eye amidst dark jagged shadows.
core_traits: Deadly fire demon born to an ice maiden clan who had the mystical Jagan eye surgically implanted onto his forehead
Allied with Yusuke Urameshi, Kurama, and Kazuma Kuwabara to defend the Human Realm as a Spirit Detective operative
Wields a lightning-fast curved katana and unleashes the devastating supernatural technique Dragon of the Darkness Flame
Secretly protects his twin sister Yukina while strictly concealing his true familial identity from her

facts_and_myths.claim: Hiei underwent agonizing surgical implantation of the third Jagan eye which temporarily stripped him of his former demonic power.
facts_and_myths.explanation: The demonic surgeon Shigure implanted the Jagan eye on Hiei, warning him that the operation would downgrade his power class from high A to lower D class.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Hiei accepted the severe risk solely so he could locate his lost mother tears stone and find his separated twin sister.

facts_and_myths.claim: Hiei was conceived as a permanent core hero of Yu Yu Hakusho from the very first chapter of the manga.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Yoshihiro Togashi originally created Hiei as an arrogant, disposable minor villain for a single three-chapter introductory heist storyline.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Overwhelming reader popularity in Weekly Shonen Jump polls convinced Togashi to bring Hiei back into the primary team.

name: Alphonse Elric
visual_anchor: Towering 9:16 vertical perspective of Alphonse Elric as a giant hollow steel suit of armor, glowing red light radiating from within his helmet visors, a blood transmutation seal visible inside the neck collar, alchemy sparks dancing along cold iron pauldrons.
core_traits: Gentle younger brother of State Alchemist Edward Elric whose entire physical body was pulled into the Gate of Truth
Spirit was soul-bound to a massive antique suit of steel armor via a blood seal drawn by his older brother
Capable of performing high-level alchemy without drawing a transmutation circle after recovering repressed memories of Truth
Longs to reclaim his flesh-and-blood human body so he can sleep, eat home cooking, and feel human warmth again

facts_and_myths.claim: Alphonse cannot feel physical sensations, cannot sleep, and cannot taste food while bound to his armor.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Because his hollow metal vessel has no nervous system, organs, or digestive tract, he spends nights awake pondering philosophy and keeping watch.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Alphonse frequently rescues stray cats by hiding them inside his hollow armor chest cavity, much to Edward's annoyance.

facts_and_myths.claim: Alphonse is the titular Fullmetal Alchemist referenced in the title of the series.
facts_and_myths.explanation: The military state alchemy title Fullmetal was granted exclusively to Edward Elric by King Bradley, though strangers frequently mistake towering Alphonse for the Fullmetal Alchemist.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Alphonse's body was preserved in the Gate of Truth for years, growing tall and emaciated while Edward unwittingly shared nourishment with it.

name: Joseph Joestar
visual_anchor: Vertical 9:16 anime action shot of young Joseph Joestar wearing a striped aviator scarf and fingerless leather gloves, striking an extravagant dramatic battle pose with purple Ripple energy crackling across clacker balls, smirk on his face amidst crumbling ancient stone ruins.
core_traits: Second JoJo protagonist of the JoJo Bizarre Adventure lineage and grandfather to Jotaro Kujo
Unorthodox Hamon martial artist famous for predicting opponent catchphrases with the quip 'Your next line is...'
Defeated ultimate ancient beings the Pillar Men, including Kars, primarily through audacious trickery and tactical bluffing
Later manifested the vine-like psychic Stand Hermit Purple in Part 3 Stardust Crusaders to track Dio Brando

facts_and_myths.claim: Joseph Joestar defeated the supreme immortal lifeform Kars by launching him into deep space using an erupting volcano.
facts_and_myths.explanation: In Battle Tendency, Joseph utilized the Red Stone of Aja to trigger a volcanic eruption that propelled the rock slab holding Kars outside Earth's atmosphere.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Kars was unable to die in the vacuum of space, eventually freezing solid and stopping thought altogether.

facts_and_myths.claim: Joseph Joestar lost his left hand during his final battle against Dio Brando in Egypt.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Joseph lost his left hand decades earlier when Kars severed it during the climax of Battle Tendency, after which the Speedwagon Foundation fitted him with a mechanical prosthetic.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Joseph's ultimate secret technique passed down to his descendants was humorously to run away at top speed.

name: Tanjiro Kamado
visual_anchor: Cinematic 9:16 vertical composition of Tanjiro Kamado in his green and black checkered haori, brandishing a pitch-black Nichirin sword with swirling water and crimson flame breathing effects amidst falling mountain snow, dramatic dynamic rim lighting, hyper-detailed anime aesthetic.
core_traits: Kind-hearted Demon Slayer who wields a black Nichirin blade and utilizes both Water Breathing and Hinokami Kagura
Recognizable by his distinctive green-and-black checkered haori, forehead scar, and hanafuda earrings
Possesses an extraordinary sense of smell that allows him to track scents, emotions, and detect openings in combat
Embarks on a perilous quest to avenge his slaughtered family and restore the humanity of his demonized sister

facts_and_myths.claim: Tanjiro's forehead mark was a Demon Slayer Mark from the moment he was born.
facts_and_myths.explanation: His original forehead mark was a burn scar caused by saving his younger brother from a falling hot kettle, which later transformed into a Demon Slayer Mark during battle.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Tanjiro has an exceptionally hard forehead, frequently using brutal headbutts to stun humans and demons alike.

facts_and_myths.claim: Tanjiro's hanafuda earrings were passed down through generations from the original Sun Breathing swordsman Yoriichi Tsugikuni.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Yoriichi Tsugikuni gave the hanafuda earrings to Tanjiro's ancestor Sumiyoshi, passing the legacy of Sun Breathing through the Kamado family's ceremonial dance.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: The earrings design was slightly modified in several international releases to avoid resemblance to historical military flags.

name: Nezuko Kamado
visual_anchor: Vertical 9:16 cinematic portrait of Nezuko Kamado in a pink patterned kimono with her bamboo muzzle, glowing pink demonic eyes, growing horn, and crimson-tipped dark hair swirling with radiant pink pyrokinesis flames, night forest setting, vibrant fantasy lighting.
core_traits: Demon Slayer sister turned into a demon who retains human emotions and fiercely protects innocent mortals
Wears a distinctive bamboo muzzle tied with red cord and travels inside a wooden backpack during daylight
Fights using powerful physical kicks and Blood Demon Art pyrokinesis that harms only demons
Restores her energy through prolonged sleep rather than consuming human blood or flesh

facts_and_myths.claim: Nezuko's bamboo muzzle is a magical restraint enchanted by the Demon Slayer Corps to suppress her demonic urges.
facts_and_myths.explanation: The bamboo muzzle is merely a physical barrier tied around her mouth by Water Hashira Giyu Tomioka to prevent her from biting people; her restraint comes from her own willpower and hypnotic conditioning.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Urokodaki used subtle hypnotic suggestion while Nezuko slept for two years, conditioning her mind to see all humans as family.

facts_and_myths.claim: Nezuko conquered the sun, becoming the first demon in centuries capable of walking in daylight without disintegrating.
facts_and_myths.explanation: During the Swordsmith Village Arc, Nezuko developed total immunity to sunlight, triggering Muzan Kibutsuji's obsessive pursuit to absorb her.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Nezuko can manipulate her physical size at will, shrinking to fit into tiny boxes or expanding into an adult demonic berserk form.

name: Eren Yeager
visual_anchor: Atmospheric 9:16 vertical shot of Eren Yeager with long dark hair tied back, draped in a dark trench coat over a fractured landscape, glowing green eyes beneath steam, colossal shadowy Titans marching in the foggy background, grim cinematic color grading.
core_traits: Survey Corps soldier driven by a fierce desire for freedom who discovers he can transform into a Titan
Inheritor of the Attack Titan, Founding Titan, and War Hammer Titan powers
Vowed to eradicate all Titans after witnessing his mother get eaten during the fall of Wall Maria
Initiator of the Rumbling, unleashing thousands of Colossal Titans upon the world outside Paradis Island

facts_and_myths.claim: Eren inherited his Titan powers because he was chosen by the royal family of Eldia.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Eren received the Attack Titan and Founding Titan from his father Grisha Yeager, who stole the Founding Titan from the royal Reiss family and injected Eren with Titan serum.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Grisha took the Founder because future Eren used the Attack Titan's cross-temporal memory transfer to manipulate him into doing so.

facts_and_myths.claim: The Attack Titan has the unique ability to peer into the memories of its future inheritors.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Unlike other Titans whose shifters can only see past memories, the Attack Titan can perceive memories of future successors, allowing Eren to influence past events.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Eren's titan design was inspired by Japanese mixed martial artist Yushin Okami.

name: Levi Ackerman
visual_anchor: High-speed 9:16 vertical action composition of Captain Levi Ackerman maneuvering with Omni-Directional Mobility gear, dual steel blades gleaming, green Survey Corps cloak billowing in wind, grappling cables anchored to giant trees amidst swirling speed lines, dynamic perspective.
core_traits: Elite captain of the Special Operations Squad celebrated as humanity's strongest soldier
Possesses extraordinary combat reflexes, spatial awareness, and lethal spinning blade techniques
Known for a stoic deadpan demeanor, short stature, and an obsessive compulsion for spotless cleanliness
Descendant of the persecuted Ackerman bloodline endowed with awakened titan-combat prowess

facts_and_myths.claim: Levi Ackerman holds a formal high military rank equivalent to general or commander in the Scout Regiment.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Levi is a Squad Captain (Heicho), not the overall military commander; Erwin Smith was Commander of the Scout Regiment while Levi commanded an elite squad.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Levi sleeps an average of two to three hours a night, often remaining upright in an armchair instead of sleeping in a bed.

facts_and_myths.claim: Levi grew up as an impoverished, malnourished street orphan in the dark Underground City before joining the Survey Corps.
facts_and_myths.explanation: After his mother Kuchel died of illness, Levi was taken in by his uncle Kenny Ackerman, who taught him knife combat and survival before abandoning him.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Levi drinks black tea obsessively and holds his teacups by the rim rather than the handle because a handle once broke off during his youth.

name: Satoru Gojo
visual_anchor: Striking 9:16 vertical composition of Satoru Gojo pulling down his black blindfold to reveal glowing azure Six Eyes, releasing the vibrant purple energy of Hollow Purple against an infinite cosmic void, floating particles, dramatic lighting, modern anime key visual style.
core_traits: Special Grade jujutsu sorcerer widely revered as the strongest living sorcerer in the world
Wielder of both the Limitless cursed technique and the legendary Six Eyes sensory perception
Teacher at Tokyo Jujutsu High recognizable by his spiky snow-white hair and iconic blindfold or dark sunglasses
Deploys the terrifying Domain Expansion: Infinite Void, overloading enemy minds with boundless information

facts_and_myths.claim: Satoru Gojo wears a blindfold because the Six Eyes make him completely blind to ordinary light.
facts_and_myths.explanation: His eyes have perfect vision; he wears a blindfold to dull his hyper-sensory perception because processing visual and cursed energy information constantly without cover exhausts his brain.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Even when wearing a pitch-black blindfold, Gojo can perceive his surroundings with thermographic-like cursed energy resolution.

facts_and_myths.claim: Gojo eats immense quantities of sweets to stimulate his brain while constantly running Reverse Cursed Technique on himself.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Constantly refreshing his brain tissue with Reverse Cursed Technique burns massive amounts of glucose, turning sweets into practical brain fuel that eventually made him a genuine dessert enthusiast.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Gojo's birth shifted the balance of the entire world, causing curses across Japan to grow stronger to match his presence.

name: Yuji Itadori
visual_anchor: Intense 9:16 vertical action frame of Yuji Itadori in his navy Tokyo Jujutsu High uniform with red hoodie collar, winding up a devastating Divergent Fist fist coated in crackling black-and-red cursed lightning, shattered concrete debris, cinematic dynamic motion.
core_traits: High school athlete who swallows a cursed talisman to save his classmates, becoming the vessel of Ryomen Sukuna
Exhibits superhuman natural strength, speed, and endurance even before learning cursed energy manipulation
Specializes in close-quarters martial arts, Divergent Fist impacts, and consecutive Black Flash strikes
Guided by his grandfather's dying wish to help people and ensure others receive a proper death

facts_and_myths.claim: Yuji Itadori was an ordinary human born by complete coincidence with natural resistance to cursed poison.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Yuji's superhuman physical traits and compatibility as Sukuna's vessel were engineered by the ancient sorcerer Kenjaku, who took over the body of Yuji's mother Kaori Itadori.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Yuji holds the record for the highest number of consecutive Black Flash strikes in jujutsu history.

facts_and_myths.claim: Yuji easily broke high school world athletic records during gym class before ever encountering jujutsu sorcery.
facts_and_myths.explanation: In the opening chapter, Yuji casually shattered a shot put throw record by launching a metal ball over thirty meters into a soccer goalpost.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Yuji can watch horror movies and dramas without flinching, a talent Gojo tested by having him control cursed energy while binge-watching films.

name: Denji
visual_anchor: Gritty 9:16 vertical action shot of Denji in his demonic Chainsaw Man transformation with whirring mechanical saw blades erupting from his helmeted head and forearms, blood splatter spraying across a rain-slicked Tokyo alley, neon reflections, raw grindhouse anime aesthetic.
core_traits: Impoverished youth who merges with his canine companion Pochita to become a chainsaw-wielding devil-human hybrid
Pulls a cord on his chest to sprout roaring chainsaw blades from his head, arms, and legs
Recruited into the Public Safety Devil Hunters Division 4 under the manipulative supervision of Makima
Motivated by simple, down-to-earth desires such as eating toast with jam and winning female affection

facts_and_myths.claim: Denji sold his right eye, kidney, and testicle to pay off debts he personally incurred from reckless gambling.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Denji sold his organs and worked as a devil hunter to pay off an astronomical inherited debt left behind by his deceased father to the Yakuza.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: When Pochita fused with Denji to become his heart, all of Denji's missing organs and right eye were completely regenerated.

facts_and_myths.claim: Chainsaw Man possesses the terrifying conceptual ability to erase devils and their names from existence by eating them.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Any devil consumed by the Chainsaw Devil is wiped from reality and human memory, including historical concepts like nuclear weapons and World War II.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Denji's favorite breakfast in the world is toast spread with butter and several different fruit jams simultaneously.

name: Sung Jinwoo
visual_anchor: Epic 9:16 vertical composition of Sung Jinwoo draped in a dark fluttering trench coat with glowing violet eyes, commanding an army of shadowy armored soldiers rising from inky purple ground mist, holding dual glowing daggers, ominous dungeon lighting.
core_traits: Former E-Rank hunter known as Humanity's Weakest Hunter who unlocks a unique video game-like System
Gains the unparalleled ability to level up infinitely through quests, stat points, and dungeon clearing
Commands the Shadow Army by extracting souls from defeated foes with the iconic command 'Arise'
Inherits the mantle and godly powers of Ashborn, the Monarch of Shadows

facts_and_myths.claim: All awakened hunters in the Solo Leveling universe can increase their rank and stats by training hard.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Hunter ranks and magical capacity are permanently fixed upon initial awakening; Sung Jinwoo is the singular exception because he was chosen by the System.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: The System was created by the Architect specifically to groom a mortal vessel capable of containing Ashborn's full power.

facts_and_myths.claim: Sung Jinwoo became the only hunter in South Korea to jump directly from E-Rank to S-Rank upon re-evaluation.
facts_and_myths.explanation: When Jinwoo finally submitted to official mana re-testing, the mana measurement device overloaded and registered him as an unprecedented S-Rank hunter.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: His first summoned named shadow soldier was Igris, the blood-red knight commander from the job change dungeon.

name: Izuku Midoriya
aliases: Ninth User of One For All
visual_anchor: Dynamic 9:16 vertical heroic shot of Izuku Midoriya in his green Deku hero costume with iron soles, green electricity crackling across his body in One For All Full Cowl, black whip tendrils spiraling through smoke, intense determined expression, high contrast anime lighting.
core_traits: Quirkless teenager chosen by the Symbol of Peace All Might to inherit the transferable Quirk One For All
Student hero in Class 1-A at U.A. High School operating under the hero moniker Deku
Analytic tactical thinker who meticulously records hero abilities in his Hero Analysis notebooks
Unlocks multiple dormant Quirks of past predecessors including Blackwhip, Float, Danger Sense, and Gearshift

facts_and_myths.claim: Izuku can pass on One For All to any person simply by having them consume his DNA against his will.
facts_and_myths.explanation: One For All can only be transferred if the current wielder genuinely wills the transfer to occur; forced DNA ingestion without intent will not transfer the Quirk.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: This intent rule was demonstrated when the hero killer Stain ingested Deku's blood without receiving One For All.

facts_and_myths.claim: Izuku's hero name 'Deku' was originally an insult meaning 'good-for-nothing' before he reclaimed it.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Katsuki Bakugo used the name to mock him as useless, but Ochaco Uraraka noted it sounded like the Japanese word for 'you can do it', inspiring Deku to embrace it.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Author Kohei Horikoshi originally conceived Midoriya as a quirkless gadget-using hero named Jack Midoriya.

name: Katsuki Bakugo
visual_anchor: Explosive 9:16 vertical action composition of Katsuki Bakugo mid-air wearing his black-and-orange tank top and grenade bracers, sparks and fiery shockwaves erupting from his outstretched palms, fierce feral grin, flying shrapnel, cinematic comic book rim lighting.
core_traits: Volatile and fiercely competitive student in U.A. High's Class 1-A with the hero name Dynamight
Wields the Quirk Explosion, secreting nitroglycerin-like sweat from his palms to detonate powerful blasts
Childhood friend and chief rival of Izuku Midoriya whom he nicknamed Deku
Combines peerless combat instincts, aerial agility, and top academic scores behind an aggressive exterior

facts_and_myths.claim: Bakugo's explosive sweat allows him to create explosions underwater or in freezing blizzards without any warm-up.
facts_and_myths.explanation: His Quirk requires sweat secretion, meaning cold environments significantly hinder his performance until he physically warms up to generate perspiration.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: His winter hero costume was specifically modified with internal heating elements to ensure he can sweat in sub-zero weather.

facts_and_myths.claim: Bakugo consistently ranked first in multiple official My Hero Academia character popularity polls.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Despite his abrasive personality and bully origins, Bakugo's character development and combat brilliance earned him the number one spot in almost every major Shonen Jump poll.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Bakugo is surprisingly skilled at domestic chores, including high-level culinary cooking and precision knife work.

name: Megumi Fushiguro
visual_anchor: Cinematic vertical 9:16 shot of Megumi Fushiguro making shadow puppet hand signs amidst swirling dark cursed energy, summoning Divine Dogs from deep floor shadows in a rain-slicked Tokyo alleyway.
core_traits: Stoic first-year student at Tokyo Jujutsu High who inherited the Zenin clan's prized Ten Shadows Technique
Uses hand puppet gestures and shadows as mediums to summon shikigami familiars into battle
Possesses an incomplete Domain Expansion known as Chimera Shadow Garden that floods the area with liquid shadow
Bears the burden of carrying the untamed trump-card divine general shikigami named Mahoraga

facts_and_myths.claim: Megumi Fushiguro was fully aware of his father Toji's true identity and past when he joined Tokyo Jujutsu High.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Megumi knew very little about his father Toji Fushiguro and did not even recognize him when they briefly clashed in Shibuya, as Satoru Gojo took guardianship over him at a young age without revealing Toji's complete history.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: His first name Megumi is traditionally a female Japanese name meaning blessing, chosen by his father Toji before abandoning the clan.

facts_and_myths.claim: Megumi is the first sorcerer in centuries from the Zenin lineage to inherit their prized hereditary Ten Shadows Technique.
facts_and_myths.explanation: The Ten Shadows Technique is one of the most revered inherited techniques in jujutsu history, directly rivaling the Gojo family's Limitless and Six Eyes.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Until Megumi summoned Mahoraga in Shibuya, no Ten Shadows user in history had ever successfully tamed the Eight-Handled Sword Divergent Sila Divine General.

name: Nobara Kugisaki
visual_anchor: Cinematic vertical 9:16 portrait of Nobara Kugisaki holding a metal hammer and glowing cursed nails, striking a voodoo straw doll with fierce confidence amidst explosive blue spark bursts in an abandoned urban building.
core_traits: Fiery and confident first-year student from the Tohoku countryside attending Tokyo Jujutsu High
Wields a metal hammer, steel nails, and a straw doll to execute the hereditary Straw Doll Technique
Channels cursed energy to perform Resonance, damaging opponents from a distance via severed body parts
Stands out for her unwavering pride in both her feminine beauty and brutal physical combat strength

facts_and_myths.claim: Nobara moved to Tokyo exclusively to pursue a noble lifelong duty of exorcising dangerous curses.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Nobara primarily moved to Tokyo to escape the stifling atmosphere of her small rural hometown, experience big-city shopping and fashion, and reconnect with her childhood friend Saori.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Her surname Kugisaki contains the kanji character for nail, matching her signature weapon.

facts_and_myths.claim: Nobara successfully landed a Black Flash during her battle alongside Yuji against the cursed womb brothers.
facts_and_myths.explanation: In the Death Painting Arc, Nobara tapped into the zone of cursed energy to unleash a devastating Black Flash simultaneously with Yuji Itadori against Kechizu and Eso.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: She uses Hairpin as a secondary application of her technique to remotely detonate nails embedded into solid objects.

name: Makima
visual_anchor: Cinematic vertical 9:16 shot of Makima standing poised in a formal black Public Safety suit with braided red hair and golden ringed spiral eyes, surrounded by attentive pet dogs in an immaculate sunlit high-rise office.
core_traits: High-ranking Public Safety Devil Hunter who takes Denji into custody as her human pet and subordinate
True identity is the Control Devil, one of the Four Horsemen embodying humanity's fear of subjugation
Possesses distinctive golden yellow eyes patterned with concentric hypnotic red circles
Manipulates invisible crushing forces from afar by sacrificing the lives of lower-tier criminals

facts_and_myths.claim: Makima harbored genuine maternal and romantic affection for Denji throughout Public Safety operations.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Makima viewed Denji purely as a vessel for Pochita the Chainsaw Devil, whom she idolized and obsessed over, while completely disregarding Denji's individual humanity.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: She recognized people primarily through scent rather than faces, which ultimately became her undoing against Denji.

facts_and_myths.claim: Makima made an official contract with the Prime Minister of Japan granting her near-total immortality.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Under her contract, any fatal injury inflicted on Makima is transferred to a random citizen of Japan in the form of an appropriate illness or accident.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: She kept a pack of numerous husky and retriever dogs in her apartment and could identify every one by name.

name: Power
visual_anchor: Cinematic vertical 9:16 action shot of Power sporting long disheveled blonde hair and red curved devil horns, gleefully manifesting a gigantic blood-red hammer above her head amidst crimson splatter and feathers.
core_traits: Unruly Blood Fiend recruited into Tokyo Special Division 4 under Aki Hayakawa and Makima
Distinctive appearance featuring long blonde-peach hair, yellow cross-patterned eyes, and red horns on her head
Manipulates her own blood to materialize sharp crimson weapons such as giant hammers and daggers
Boastful, selfish, and chaotic roommate who cares deeply for her pet cat named Meowy

facts_and_myths.claim: Power maintains strict personal cleanliness and hygiene habits to preserve her fiend biology.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Power is notorious for hating baths, refusing to flush toilets, and eating almost exclusively meat while throwing vegetables onto the floor.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: She frequently boasts that she will run for Prime Minister of Japan and establish a 100 percent sales tax.

facts_and_myths.claim: Power betrayed Denji early in the story by luring him to the Bat Devil to save her beloved cat.
