Wears round amber-tinted glasses and conceals his true royal bloodline heritage under the Laputian name Romuska Palo Ur Laputa
Unleashes ancient robotic sentinels and lightning weapons of mass destruction against the military dreadnought Goliath
Main antagonist in Hayao Miyazaki's 1986 debut Studio Ghibli masterpiece Castle in the Sky

facts_and_myths.claim: Muska shares a common Laputian royal ancestry with Princess Sheeta.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Both Muska and Sheeta are descendants of two separate branches of the Laputian royal dynasty that abandoned the sky fortress centuries ago to live on Earth.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Muska's cry of 'My eyes! My eyes!' when blinded by the Spell of Destruction became a legendary Internet meme in Japan.

facts_and_myths.claim: Muska planned to deliver Laputa's ancient technology directly to his kingdom's king and generals.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Muska betrayed the military forces completely, slaughtering General Muoro and his soldiers from Laputa's observation dome while declaring himself supreme emperor of the world.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Mark Hamill, famed for playing Luke Skywalker and the Joker, voiced Colonel Muska in Disney's 2003 English dub.

name: Arrietty
visual_anchor: Tiny fourteen-year-old Borrower girl Arrietty in a vivid crimson dress with a large golden clothespin hairclip, carrying a metal sewing needle as a rapier among towering lush garden ferns, 9:16 vertical Studio Ghibli cinematic animation style.
core_traits: Fourteen-year-old Borrower girl who stands four inches tall and lives secretly beneath the floorboards of a suburban house
Uses a large golden clothespin as a hairclip and carries a polished metal sewing needle as a defensive sword
Forms a forbidden, gentle friendship with a sickly human boy named Shawn who is resting before heart surgery
Spirited protagonist of the 2010 Studio Ghibli film based on Mary Norton's beloved fantasy novel The Borrowers

facts_and_myths.claim: The Borrowers only take tiny quantities of household items that human householders will never notice missing.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Borrower philosophy dictates taking single sugar cubes, tissue sheets, or dropped pins so humans never realize tiny people share their home.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Studio Ghibli co-founders Isao Takahata and Hayao Miyazaki had wanted to adapt Mary Norton's book for roughly forty years before production began.

facts_and_myths.claim: Arrietty and her family decided to stay living under the house after Shawn defended them from the housekeeper.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Once discovered by the housekeeper Haru, the family was forced to pack their belongings and migrate along the river to survive in the wild.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Bridgit Mendler voiced Arrietty in the North American Disney release, while Saoirse Ronan voiced her in the British English dub.

name: Seita Yokokawa
visual_anchor: Fourteen-year-old boy Seita in a faded World War Two Japanese student uniform holding a glowing firefly jar next to an abandoned bomb shelter cave beside a moonlit rice paddy, emotional 9:16 vertical cinematic anime portrait.
core_traits: Fourteen-year-old Japanese boy who struggles desperately to protect and feed his younger sister during World War Two
Flees his unkind aunt's household following the firebombing of Kobe to live independently in a rural bomb shelter
Carries a metal fruit drops tin containing candy and later the cremated remains of his beloved little sister
Tragic protagonist of Isao Takahata's critically acclaimed 1988 Studio Ghibli war drama Grave of the Fireflies

facts_and_myths.claim: The character of Seita is based on the real childhood experiences of author Akiyuki Nosaka.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Nosaka wrote the semi-autobiographical 1967 short story as a grief-stricken apology to his foster sister Keiko, who starved to death during the war.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Grave of the Fireflies was released in Japanese theaters as a double feature alongside Hayao Miyazaki's upbeat classic My Neighbor Totoro.

facts_and_myths.claim: Seita was drafted as an active frontline kamikaze pilot before the war came to an end.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Seita was only a fourteen-year-old middle school student who never served as a soldier or pilot, spending his final days wandering Kobe after losing his home.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: The ghostly spirits of Seita and Setsuko watch over a modernized, glowing Kobe skyline in the final frame of the movie.

name: Setsuko Yokokawa
visual_anchor: Four-year-old girl Setsuko in a patterned floral monpe playsuit clutching a green Sakuma drops candy tin, standing amidst a swirling constellation of glowing yellow fireflies outside a dark hillside bunker at night, 9:16 vertical anime composition.
core_traits: Four-year-old Japanese girl who relies unconditionally on her older teenage brother following their mother's death in the firebombing of Kobe
Treasures a tin can of Sakuma fruit-flavored hard candies, filling the empty tin with water to taste the lingering sweetness
Digs a tiny grave for fallen fireflies in the grass after learning that insects and human beings alike must die
Heartbreaking deuteragonist of Isao Takahata's 1988 Studio Ghibli historical masterpiece Grave of the Fireflies

facts_and_myths.claim: Setsuko's voice actress Ayano Shiraishi was only five years old when she recorded the dialogue for the film.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Director Isao Takahata insisted on recording a genuine Kansai-accented five-year-old child before animating the mouth movements to capture realistic childlike emotion and speech.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Sakuma Confectionery released limited-edition replica tins of the iconic fruit drops featured in the movie.

facts_and_myths.claim: Setsuko died from severe burns sustained directly during the firebombing of Kobe.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Setsuko escaped the physical flames of the air raid uninjured, but later succumbed tragically to acute malnutrition and gastrointestinal illness in the shelter.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Setsuko mistakenly made mud balls believing they were rice balls when delirium set in from starvation.

name: Light Yagami
visual_anchor: A sharp-dressed genius high school student holding a black notebook with a fountain pen, sinister red eyes reflecting moonlight against shadows in vertical 9:16 portrait view.
core_traits: Top-ranking high school prodigy who discovers a supernatural notebook dropped by a Shinigami
Adopts the worldwide alias Kira while executing criminals to reshape society into his ideal utopia
Possesses extraordinary strategic intellect, outsmarting police agencies and global investigators
Engages in a legendary psychological cat-and-mouse duel with the eccentric master detective L

facts_and_myths.claim: Light Yagami was born with psychopathic traits and always desired to kill criminals before finding the notebook.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Series creators emphasized that Light was an innocent, morally upright student whose absolute power corrupted him after finding the Death Note.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Writer Tsugumi Ohba noted that if Light had never picked up the notebook, he would have become a premier police detective alongside his father.

facts_and_myths.claim: Light hid a miniature liquid crystal television inside an ordinary potato chip bag to secretly monitor news broadcasts while being bugged.
facts_and_myths.explanation: To bypass FBI and Japanese police video surveillance in his bedroom, Light concealed a mini LCD screen inside a bag of chips while studying.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: The dramatic declaration 'I'll take a potato chip... and eat it!' became one of the most famous viral memes in anime history.

name: L Lawliet
visual_anchor: A disheveled pale detective with dark eye bags crouching barefoot on an armchair, holding a strawberry sweet between two fingers under cold fluorescent light in vertical 9:16 framing.
core_traits: World-renowned secretive consulting detective recognized by Interpol as the supreme solver of impossible international crimes
Characterized by unique physical quirks including crouching posture, barefoot habit, and insatiable appetite for confectionery
Asserts that sitting in an unconventional hunched posture boosts deductive reasoning capability by approximately forty percent
Employs audacious psychological traps and televised gambits to narrow down the identity and location of Kira

facts_and_myths.claim: L consumes immense quantities of sugary desserts simply because he cannot taste savory food.
facts_and_myths.explanation: L eats sweets purely for rapid caloric glucose intake to fuel his intense brain activity, not due to an impaired sense of taste.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: He explicitly claimed he stays thin because his brain burns all the calories consumed from junk food.

facts_and_myths.claim: L was raised in an elite English orphanage called Wammy's House founded to cultivate extraordinary intellectual prodigies.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Wammy's House in Winchester, England, founded by Quillsh Wammy (Watari), served as a sanctuary and training facility for gifted orphan successors.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Watari discovered L when L was eight years old and helped prevent an international financial disaster using L's advice.

name: Ryuk
visual_anchor: A tall monstrous death god with spiky black hair, bulging round yellow eyes, a gaping stitched grin, and black feathered wings floating in a gloomy room in vertical 9:16 aspect.
core_traits: Bored supernatural Shinigami who intentionally drops a lethal supernatural notebook into the human world
Visible only to individuals who physically touch the pages of the notebook he discarded
Exhibits an obsessive physiological addiction to juicy human world red apples, experiencing severe withdrawal symptoms without them
Maintains a neutral, non-interfering role as an amused spectator in the conflict between human masterminds

facts_and_myths.claim: Ryuk dropped the Death Note to Earth because he sympathized with humans and wanted to eradicate corrupt criminals.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Ryuk had zero ideological agenda and dropped the notebook purely out of sheer boredom because the Shinigami realm had become dull and inactive.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: In the Shinigami realm, death gods mostly spent their days gambling with skull dice or sleeping.

facts_and_myths.claim: Ryuk suffers from severe physical withdrawal symptoms, including twisting his body into a pretzel, when deprived of apples.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Because apples are like cigarettes or alcohol to Shinigami, lacking them causes Ryuk to perform involuntary handstands and contortions.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Ryuk stated that apples in the Shinigami realm taste like dry sand, making juicy Earth apples irresistible.

name: Conan Edogawa
visual_anchor: A young schoolboy detective wearing oversized round glasses, a blue blazer, and a red bow-tie, aiming an tranquilizer wristwatch in dynamic 9:16 vertical composition.
core_traits: Brilliant teenage high school sleuth transformed into an elementary child by a sinister experimental poison called APTX 4869
Adopted his alias on the fly from mystery authors Arthur Conan Doyle and Edogawa Ranpo
Solves complex homicides and locked-room mysteries while posing behind surrogate detectives using voice-modulating gadgets
Relentlessly pursues the shadowy criminal syndicate known as the Black Organization

facts_and_myths.claim: Conan's tranquilizer watch needle dissolves inside victims without leaving any traces or physical buildup.
facts_and_myths.explanation: In the narrative lore and creator notes, the tiny anesthetic needles do not dissolve, meaning Kogoro Mouri has hundreds of micro-needles lodged in his neck.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Fans calculated that Kogoro Mouri was put to sleep over five hundred times across the long-running series.

facts_and_myths.claim: The prototype poison APTX 4869 was intended by the Black Organization to be an untraceable lethal toxin rather than a shrinking drug.
facts_and_myths.explanation: The drug was engineered to induce cellular apoptosis without leaving poison residue in autopsies; de-aging was a rare, unintended biological anomaly.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: The acronym APTX stands for Apoptoxin, highlighting its programmed cell death mechanism.

name: Kaitou Kid
visual_anchor: An elegant gentleman phantom thief in an immaculate white tuxedo, flowing silk cape, monocle, and white top hat standing atop a moonlit skyscraper in vertical 9:16 view.
core_traits: High school magician who assumes a legendary phantom thief persona to investigate the mysterious death of his father
Renowned for sending poetic heist notices and performing spectacular theatrical escapes using hang gliders and smoke bombs
Master of disguise who can mimic anyone's physical appearance and voice flawlessly without electronic modulation
Targets rare gems under intense moonlight to discover and destroy the mythical immortality stone Pandora

facts_and_myths.claim: Kaitou Kid keeps all the priceless multi-million-dollar jewels and diamonds he steals during his famous heists.
facts_and_myths.explanation: He routinely returns or abandons stolen jewels after examining them under moonlight to verify they do not contain the Pandora gem.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: He often leaves returned gems with the police or hands them back to their original owners in witty puzzle boxes.

facts_and_myths.claim: The international secret police code number 1412 was misread as KID by a famous mystery novelist.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Novelist Yusaku Kudo scribbled the case designation number 1412 by hand, which looked like the word KID in cursive script, creating the alias.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Despite being arch-rivals, Kaito Kuroba and Shinichi Kudo are uncanny physical lookalikes who share the same voice actor.

name: Lelouch vi Britannia
visual_anchor: A charismatic revolutionary mastermind in a sweeping black-and-gold cape, holding a flowing helmet while his left eye gleams with a bird-shaped crimson Geass sigil in 9:16 vertical view.
core_traits: Exiled Britannian prince turned tactical insurgent who commands the rebel organization known as the Black Knights
Wields the Geass supernatural eye ability, allowing him to enforce absolute, unquestioned mental obedience upon any person once
Adopts the masked alter-ego Zero to dismantle the tyrannical Holy Britannian Empire and forge a peaceful world for his sister
Superb chess player who treats real-world battlefield warfare and geopolitical conflicts like dynamic tactical board games

facts_and_myths.claim: Lelouch can command the exact same person multiple times using his Power of Absolute Obedience.
facts_and_myths.explanation: The fundamental limitation of Lelouch's Geass is that it can only be activated on any single human being once in their lifetime.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: If a person's memory is erased or modified, the one-time Geass restriction still persists without resetting.

facts_and_myths.claim: Lelouch orchestrated his own public assassination under the strategic master plan called the Zero Requiem.
facts_and_myths.explanation: He deliberately concentrated the hatred of the entire world upon himself as Emperor, arranging for Zero to slay him to unite humanity in peace.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: His childhood best friend Suzaku Kururugi donned the Zero mantle to deliver the planned fatal strike.

name: C.C.
visual_anchor: An enigmatic immortal woman with long lime-green hair, golden-amber eyes, and a white straitjacket bondage outfit, surrounded by plush cheese mascots in cinematic 9:16 vertical portrait.
core_traits: Immortal green-haired bearer of the supernatural Code who bestows the Geass power upon human candidates via binding contracts
Possesses complete cellular regeneration and ageless immortality, surviving fatal gunshot wounds and extreme physical trauma
Serves as the primary confidante, strategic partner, and co-conspirator to Lelouch vi Britannia throughout his revolution
Exhibits a quirky, insatiable obsession with ordering take-out pizza and collecting Cheese-kun mascot merchandise

facts_and_myths.claim: C.C. can actively cast mental Geass illusions and mind-control commands on enemies during combat.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Because she holds a mature Code, she cannot wield active Geass ocular powers; she can only bestow Geass, convey telepathy, and exhibit immortality.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Before gaining her Code in medieval Europe, her original Geass ability was making anyone love her unconditionally.

facts_and_myths.claim: C.C.'s immense love for Pizza Hut pizza in the anime was part of a major real-world commercial sponsorship campaign in Japan.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Pizza Hut sponsored the anime production in Japan, resulting in frequent appearances of real Pizza Hut delivery boxes throughout the series.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: She frequently used Lelouch's credit card without permission to rack up enormous pizza delivery bills.

name: Ken Kaneki
visual_anchor: A haunted young man with stark white hair, wearing a one-eyed leather ghoul mask with exposed teeth and releasing glowing crimson predatory tentacles in vertical 9:16 dark lighting.
core_traits: Gentle literature university student turned into an artificial one-eyed half-ghoul following an organ transplant from Rize Kamishiro
Struggles with agonizing identity fragmentation between human morality and predatory ghoul biology requiring human flesh
Wields a deadly rinkaku kagune resembling four red scaly tentacles sprouting from his lower back
Undergoes traumatic psychological transformation under brutal torture, embracing his predatory strength and developing white hair

facts_and_myths.claim: Ken Kaneki's hair turned white instantly because he inherited dormant ghoul genetic pigment from Rize Kamishiro.
facts_and_myths.explanation: His hair turned white due to extreme psychological stress, physical trauma, and the real-world medical phenomenon known as Marie Antoinette syndrome.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: During his ten days of continuous torture by Yamori, his fingers and toes were repeatedly amputated and regenerated.

facts_and_myths.claim: Kaneki developed a compulsive habit of cracking his index finger with his thumb after defeating his torturer Yamori.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Kaneki psychologically adopted Yamori's signature finger-cracking gesture, a behavioral mimicry that Yamori himself had copied from an earlier torturer.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Kaneki also possesses an unconscious tic of touching his chin with his left hand whenever he is concealing the truth.

name: Johan Liebert
visual_anchor: A handsome blonde young man in a beige trench coat with an empty, chillingly polite gaze, standing motionless in a shadowy rain-swept European town square in vertical 9:16 ratio.
core_traits: Charismatic, cold-blooded psychological manipulator often described as the second coming of Adolf Hitler or the devil himself
Product of secret psychological experiments at the notorious East German orphanage Kinderheim 511
Possesses supernatural-level rhetoric and psychological insight, capable of driving people to murder or suicide through mere conversation
Saved as a young boy with a gunshot wound to the head by the idealistic brain surgeon Dr. Kenzo Tenma

facts_and_myths.claim: Johan Liebert possesses supernatural telepathic and hypnotic powers that force victims to obey him against their will.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Johan has zero supernatural powers; his terrifying lethal influence stems purely from peak human charisma, rhetorical deception, and psychological insight into human trauma.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Author Naoki Urasawa designed Johan as an embodiment of pure nihilism rather than a fantasy villain.

facts_and_myths.claim: Johan disguised himself as his twin sister Nina Liebert on multiple occasions to evade detection and manipulate German authorities.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Thanks to identical bone structure and blonde features, Johan convincingly cross-dressed as his sister Anna (Nina) to execute covert crimes.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Their mother once had to make a horrific split-second choice between the two identical twins during an experimental selection.

name: Dr. Kenzo Tenma
visual_anchor: A tired Japanese neurosurgeon with unkempt hair and a worn trench coat holding a surgical scalpel in front of an abandoned hospital room in moody 9:16 vertical view.
core_traits: Extraordinarily skilled Japanese brain surgeon working at the prestigious Eisler Memorial Hospital in Dusseldorf, Germany
Chooses to operate on an injured orphan boy instead of the city mayor based on his strict moral conviction that all human lives are equal
Becomes a framed fugitive across Germany and the Czech Republic after discovering the boy he saved is a sociopathic monster
Trains under professional mercenaries in marksmanship while wrestling with the ethical crisis of taking a life to save others

facts_and_myths.claim: Dr. Tenma originally set out on his fugitive journey across Europe with the goal of proving his innocence to the police.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Tenma prioritized finding and eliminating Johan to prevent further murders and shoulder personal responsibility for reviving him, rather than clearing his own name.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: He repeatedly evaded Inspector Heinrich Lunge of the BKA, who mistakenly believed Tenma had a split personality.

facts_and_myths.claim: Dr. Tenma underwent rigorous combat and firearms training under an ex-mercenary soldier named Hugo Bernhardt.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Recognizing his physical limitations, Tenma learned tactical marksmanship and handgun handling from Bernhardt to prepare for hunting Johan.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Despite acquiring lethal shooting proficiency, Tenma's innate reverence for human life made pulling the trigger an agonizing ordeal.

name: Misa Amane
visual_anchor: Dramatic vertical 9:16 portrait of blonde gothic-lolita model Misa Amane holding a black Death Note journal against her chest, her red Shinigami Eyes glowing fiercely beneath soft studio spotlights in a dark Tokyo apartment.
core_traits: Popular Japanese idol and model who becomes the second Kira after acquiring a Death Note dropped by Gelus.
Possesses the Shinigami Eyes, allowing her to see any human's true name and remaining lifespan above their head.
Obsessively devoted to Light Yagami after Kira executes the burglar who murdered her parents.
Accompanied by the loyal Shinigami Rem, who ultimately sacrifices her own life to save Misa from execution.

facts_and_myths.claim: Misa made the Shinigami Eye deal only once during the entire story.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Misa made the eye deal twice with two different Shinigami (Rem and Ryuk), cutting her remaining lifespan in half both times.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Despite cutting her lifespan in half twice, she lived through the main events of the story because she had inherited the lifespan of Gelus, who died saving her.

facts_and_myths.claim: Misa survived an attack by a stalker because a Shinigami fell in love with her and died to protect her.
facts_and_myths.explanation: The Shinigami Gelus observed Misa from the Shinigami Realm, fell in love with her, and wrote the stalker's name to save her, turning Gelus into dust.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Gelus's Death Note was retrieved by Rem and gifted directly to Misa, setting her path as the Second Kira.

name: Near
visual_anchor: High-angle vertical 9:16 composition of white-haired orphan genius Near sitting hunched on the floor, twirling a strand of hair with one hand while stacking intricate multi-tiered white dice towers inside SPK headquarters.
core_traits: Gifted orphan raised at Wammy's House in Winchester, England as the primary successor to the master detective L.
Leads the Special Provision for Kira (SPK), an independent investigation task force sanctioned by the United States government.
Habitually plays with intricate toys, stacking dice, dartboards, and finger puppets while deducing criminal motives.
Outwits Light Yagami and Teru Mikami during the final confrontation at the Yellow Box warehouse.

facts_and_myths.claim: Near admits in the finale that he and Mello could only surpass L by working together.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Near explicitly states that while neither he nor Mello could match L individually, their combined parallel efforts allowed them to expose Kira.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Mello's kidnapping of Kiyomi Takada forced Mikami to retrieve the real notebook, which revealed Light's trap to Near.

facts_and_myths.claim: Near's real name Nate River was kept completely secret and never revealed in any official Death Note publication.
facts_and_myths.explanation: His true birth name, Nate River, was officially revealed in 'Death Note 13: How to Read' along with his exact birthdate and blood type.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: The name Near comes from 'Nate' and signifies someone who is always close to the truth.

name: Ran Mouri
visual_anchor: Vibrant vertical 9:16 framing of high school martial artist Ran Mouri in a crisp Teitan High blue uniform, executing an athletic high karate roundhouse kick with focused amber eyes and her signature horn-shaped front hair.
core_traits: Headstrong Teitan High School student and captain of the school karate club, possessing national championship martial arts skills.
Childhood friend, romantic interest, and classmate of teenage high school detective Shinichi Kudo.
Lives at the Mouri Detective Agency with her father Kogoro and watches over young Conan Edogawa as a protective surrogate elder sister.
Referred to affectionately as 'Angel' by Vermouth after Ran heroically saves her life in New York City.

facts_and_myths.claim: Ran Mouri has repeatedly suspected that Conan Edogawa is actually Shinichi Kudo throughout the series.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Ran has figured out Conan's secret identity multiple times, only for Conan, Hiroshi Agasa, or disguised allies like Kaito Kid to stage elaborate deceptions.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: At one point Ran took Conan's mobile phone to check his messages, but Shinichi managed to call her simultaneously with Agasa's help.

facts_and_myths.claim: Ran knows that Conan uses a stun-gun wristwatch to knock out her father Kogoro during case solutions.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Ran remains completely unaware of Conan's sleep-inducing darts and genuinely believes Kogoro falls into a bizarre deep trance while solving mysteries.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: She often expresses pride and concern over her father's famous 'Sleeping Kogoro' phenomenon without ever realizing Conan is the voice behind it.

name: Kogoro Mouri
visual_anchor: Humorous vertical 9:16 composition of mustachioed private eye Kogoro Mouri slumping asleep in a brown swivel chair with head tilted back, a limp cigarette in an ashtray, as Conan aims a stun wristwatch from behind.
core_traits: Former Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department officer turned bumbling private investigator running the Mouri Detective Agency.
Nationally celebrated as 'Sleeping Kogoro' after seemingly falling unconscious while delivering brilliant deductive reasoning.
Enthusiastic gambler, heavy beer drinker, and devoted fanboy of pop idol Yoko Okino.
Estranged husband of top defense attorney Eri Kisaki and protective father of karate ace Ran Mouri.

facts_and_myths.claim: Kogoro Mouri has never solved a single criminal mystery on his own without Conan's secret intervention.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Kogoro has independently cracked several major cases, especially when his loved ones, old friends, or estranged wife Eri Kisaki are directly threatened.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: During his class reunion murder case, Kogoro rejected Conan's tranquilizer dart and deduced the true culprit entirely through his own forensic logic.

facts_and_myths.claim: Kogoro was once a police marksman with the highest shooting accuracy in his entire police academy class.
facts_and_myths.explanation: During his tenure as an officer under Inspector Megure, Kogoro was an elite sharpshooter whose handgun accuracy was unmatched among peers.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: In Movie 2, Kogoro shot his own wife Eri in the leg during a hostage standoff to render her useless as a human shield, successfully saving her life.

name: Toru Amuro
visual_anchor: Dynamic vertical 9:16 shot of blond undercover operative Toru Amuro wearing a black turtleneck and leather jacket, standing beside his white Mazda RX-7 in a shadowed Tokyo alleyway under flickering streetlights.
core_traits: Elite undercover agent of Japan's National Police Agency Public Security Bureau operating under the covert codename 'Zero'.
Infiltrated the sinister Black Organization under the executive alcohol codename 'Bourbon' as an expert reconnaissance specialist.
Works part-time as a polite, charismatic waiter and amateur apprentice detective at Cafe Poirot beneath the Mouri Detective Agency.
Drives an iconic white Mazda RX-7 FD3S and harbors an intense personal grudge against FBI agent Shuichi Akai.

facts_and_myths.claim: Toru Amuro maintains three distinct secret personas simultaneously throughout the narrative.
facts_and_myths.explanation: He lives as civilian waiter Toru Amuro, Black Organization operative Bourbon, and senior Public Security officer Rei Furuya.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: His real name Rei Furuya is an anagram-style homage to iconic Gundam protagonist Amuro Ray and his voice actor Toru Furuya.

facts_and_myths.claim: Bourbon originally joined the Black Organization as a villain before the author decided to make him an undercover agent.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Author Gosho Aoyama confirmed that although Bourbon was initially planned as a villainous antagonist, he decided to make him a heroic triple-agent early during his debut arc due to his cool demeanor.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Amuro's explosive popularity in Japan made his 2018 standalone film 'Zero the Enforcer' one of the highest-grossing anime movies in Japanese history.

name: Shuichi Akai
visual_anchor: Atmospheric vertical 9:16 profile of FBI marksman Shuichi Akai wearing his black knit cap, aiming a customized long-range sniper rifle through driving rain from a skyscraper rooftop, glowing green eyes narrowing.
core_traits: Master FBI sniper and strategic field operative known throughout criminal underworlds as the feared 'Silver Bullet'.
Infiltrated the Black Organization under the codename 'Rye' before his undercover status was exposed by a comrade's mistake.
Disguised himself as quiet graduate student Subaru Okiya and resided at Shinichi Kudo's mansion after faking his own death.
Practices Jeet Kune Do and possesses extraordinary extreme-range marksmanship exceeding 1,300 yards.

facts_and_myths.claim: Shuichi Akai faked his death at Raiha Pass with the direct forensic collaboration of Conan Edogawa.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Conan and Akai staged his assassination by Kir using the corpse of Organization member Rikumichi Kusuda to fool Gin and the Syndicate.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Akai used temporary burn scars, neck disguise chokers designed by Agasa, and fake blood packs hidden inside his knit cap.

facts_and_myths.claim: Shuichi Akai is completely unrelated to the Miyano scientist family who developed the APTX 4869 poison.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Akai is actually a first cousin to Shiho Miyano (Ai Haibara) and Akemi Miyano, as his mother Mary Sera and their mother Elena Miyano are biological sisters.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Akai originally entered a romantic relationship with Akemi Miyano to infiltrate the Syndicate, unaware at the time that they were related cousins.

name: Suzaku Kururugi
visual_anchor: Cinematic vertical 9:16 full-body depiction of Suzaku Kururugi standing before the white-and-gold Lancelot Knightmare Frame, dressed in his ceremonial Knight of Seven uniform with green cape billowing against a burning battleground.
core_traits: Son of Japan's last prime minister Genbu Kururugi who voluntarily enlists as an Honorary Britannian soldier.
Pilots the experimental white seventh-generation Knightmare Frame Lancelot with superhuman acrobatic reflexes.
Advocates reforming the corrupt Holy Britannian Empire from within through righteous means rather than violent terrorism.
Commands the absolute Geass command 'Live!' placed upon him by childhood best friend and arch-rival Lelouch vi Britannia.

facts_and_myths.claim: Suzaku murdered his own father Genbu Kururugi before the events of the Britannian invasion concluded.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Suzaku killed his father during the war when Genbu refused to surrender and advocated fanatical mass suicide for Japanese forces.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: The immense guilt from this patricide drove Suzaku's subconscious death wish and martyr complex throughout the entire anime series.

facts_and_myths.claim: Suzaku inherited a mystical Geass power of his own that allows him to pilot Knightmares with precognition.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Suzaku never contracted a Geass of his own; his superhuman combat survival stems from Lelouch's involuntary Geass command forcing him to survive at all costs.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Whenever Suzaku is faced with imminent death, the 'Live!' Geass triggers automatically, temporarily overriding his conscious mind and enhancing his adrenaline.

name: Touka Kirishima
visual_anchor: Stunning vertical 9:16 dynamic framing of Touka Kirishima in a shredded dark hoodie and rabbit mask, her single fiery crimson-and-blue Ukaku wing unfurling into crystallization amidst a neon-drenched rainy Tokyo night.
core_traits: Ukaku-type ghoul waitress working at Anteiku, a peaceful cafe in the 20th ward providing sanctuary for non-predatory ghouls.
Attends Kiyomi High School while desperately trying to blend into normal human society alongside her human friend Yoriko.
Fierce combatant known to Commission of Counter Ghoul (CCG) investigators as the vengeful vigilante 'Rabbit'.
Serves as a tough mentor and protector to newly transformed half-ghoul Ken Kaneki, whom she later marries.

facts_and_myths.claim: Touka Kirishima was born an artificial one-eyed ghoul through an organ transplant like Ken Kaneki.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Touka was born a pure natural ghoul to two ghoul parents, Arata and Hikari Kirishima, alongside her younger brother Ayato.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Because natural ghouls cannot digest human food without severe sickness, Touka routinely forced herself to eat Yoriko's homemade lunches to protect their friendship.

facts_and_myths.claim: Touka suffers from severe ornithophobia, an intense psychological terror of birds.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Her fear of birds originated in childhood when an injured baby bird she nursed pecked her near her right eye, traumatizing her.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Ironically, despite her phobia of birds, CCG assigned her the codename Rabbit, and her Ukaku kagune resembles radiant fiery bird wings.

name: Shinya Kogami
visual_anchor: Gritty vertical 9:16 composition of rugged detective Shinya Kogami in a wrinkled black suit, smoking a Spinel cigarette in the rain while pointing a glowing blue Dominator pistol toward dark futuristic skyscrapers.
core_traits: Former elite Inspector demoted to Enforcer in the Public Safety Bureau's Criminal Investigation Department Division 1.
Suffered a clouded Crime Coefficient and latent criminal classification while obsessively investigating the brutal murder of his partner Mitsuru Sasayama.
Possesses brilliant criminological intuition, keen analytical profiling skills, and expert mastery of Silat martial arts.
Rivals the criminally asymptomatic intellectual mastermind Shogo Makishima in philosophical ideals and lethal single combat.

facts_and_myths.claim: Kogami killed his archenemy Shogo Makishima using a vintage conventional firearm rather than a Dominator.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Because Makishima was criminally asymptomatic and could not be judged lethal by the Sibyl System's Dominator, Kogami tracked him down with an antique revolver.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Kogami voluntarily abandoned the Public Safety Bureau and fled Japan as an international mercenary after executing Makishima.

facts_and_myths.claim: Kogami's Crime Coefficient deteriorated because he held violent psychopathic tendencies since early childhood.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Kogami originally maintained a completely pristine Psycho-Pass and top academy marks; his score deteriorated purely from psychological trauma and vengeful obsession.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Inspector Nobuchika Ginoza was Kogami's former classmate who watched in anguish as Kogami's obsession dragged him down to Enforcer rank.

name: Akane Tsunemori
visual_anchor: Intense vertical 9:16 portrait of Inspector Akane Tsunemori holding a sleek Dominator handgun with glowing cyan circuitry, her short brown bob and determined hazel eyes illuminated by rain-slicked cyberpunk street holograms.
core_traits: Rookie Inspector assigned to Public Safety Bureau Criminal Investigation Department Division 1 after scoring top aptitude marks nationwide.
Maintains an extraordinarily resilient, crystal-clear Psycho-Pass Hue that recovers rapidly even under extreme emotional stress.
Discovers the shocking truth behind the Sibyl System's hive-mind composition of criminally asymptomatic brains yet chooses to uphold order.
Evolves from an idealistic, naive rookie into an uncompromising, tactical leader defending civil rights and legal ethics.

facts_and_myths.claim: Akane's Psycho-Pass clouded into latent criminal territory when she witnessed her best friend murdered by Shogo Makishima.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Even when forced to watch Makishima slit her friend Yuki's throat, Akane's Crime Coefficient remained below lethal levels and swiftly restored to clear blue.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Her mental resilience was so unique that the Sibyl System deemed her an ideal outsider referee to evaluate humanity's future.

facts_and_myths.claim: Akane shot her own partner Shinya Kogami with a paralyzer Dominator during her very first field mission.
facts_and_myths.explanation: On her first case, she shot Enforcer Kogami with a stun shot to stop him from executing a traumatized hostage whose Psycho-Pass had spiked temporarily.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Her controversial decision saved the hostage's life, earning Kogami's immediate respect and establishing her moral authority over Division 1.

name: Shogo Makishima
visual_anchor: Cinematic vertical 9:16 shot of Shogo Makishima with shoulder-length white hair and amber eyes holding a vintage straight razor, standing amidst towering rain-swept dystopian cyberpunk skyscrapers under glowing holographic surveillance drones.
core_traits: Criminally asymptomatic mastermind capable of committing horrific acts without clouding his Crime Coefficient
Charismatic humanist philosopher and bibliophile who quotes classic literature like George Orwell and Philip K. Dick
Primary intellectual antagonist opposed to the algorithmic Sibyl System governing dystopian Tokyo
Wields a customized cutthroat straight razor and engages in deadly physical combat against Enforcer Shinya Kogami

facts_and_myths.claim: Shogo Makishima only reads physical paper books and actively refuses to consume digital literature on electronic screens.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Makishima explicitly argues that paper books engage all sensory faculties including scent and touch, keeping a large physical collection of vintage printed texts.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: During his rooftop duel, he quotes Joseph Conrad's Heart of Darkness and Blaise Pascal's Pensees from memory.

facts_and_myths.claim: Shogo Makishima possesses a cybernetic body upgrade that masks his biological stress signals from the Dominator guns.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Makishima is completely human with no cybernetic brain modifications; his Crime Coefficient remains near zero due to his unique psychology being Criminally Asymptomatic.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Director Gen Urobuchi stated that Makishima was inspired by the concept of someone who truly loves humanity and free will yet chooses cruelty to awaken people.

name: Norman
visual_anchor: Dramatic vertical 9:16 composition of a white-haired young boy wearing a crisp white orphanage uniform with identification tattoo 22194 on his neck, planning intricate tactical battle maps under dim lantern illumination inside an abandoned hideout.
core_traits: Genius prodigy and master tactician bearing the identification number 22194 tattooed on the left side of his neck
Consistently scores perfect marks on daily intelligence exams alongside Emma and Ray at Grace Field House
Willing to sacrifice his own life and assume the ruthless identity of William Minerva to eradicate all demons
Sent away for early shipment from the orphanage, later leading the Lambda resistance force

facts_and_myths.claim: Norman was sent to the experimental facility Lambda 7214 after his staged shipment from Grace Field House.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Instead of being slaughtered immediately, Norman was transferred to the specialized Lambda research facility run by Peter Ratri to study high-IQ human cattle.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: At Lambda, Norman experienced seizures due to experimental drug trials aimed at accelerating intellectual development.

facts_and_myths.claim: Norman was genetically cloned from original human world founder James Ratri in the Lambda breeding facility.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Norman is a naturally born human child who was simply raised in Plant 3 of Grace Field House as premium grade cattle.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Norman had frail physical health and caught colds easily as a child, relying on Emma and Ray to play tag outside.

name: Emma
visual_anchor: Vibrant vertical 9:16 action illustration of an athletic girl with wild orange hair and green eyes running through a mysterious forest with a wooden bow, showing the neck tattoo 63194 under dramatic golden hour foliage sunlight.
core_traits: Extraordinarily athletic and deeply empathetic orphan bearing the identification number 63194 on her neck
Discovered the dark truth of Grace Field House after finding Conny's stuffed bunny Little Bernie at the gate
Adamantly refuses to leave any sibling behind, formulating a daring escape plan for all forty-three children
Cuts off her own left ear to remove an implanted tracking transmitter and deceive Mother Isabella

facts_and_myths.claim: Emma purposely severed her own left ear to disable a tracking device implanted beneath her skin.
facts_and_myths.explanation: To keep Mama Isabella from tracking her movements during the great orphanage escape, Emma sliced off her own ear and bandaged her head.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Her distinctive single standing tuft of orange hair is affectionately called an antenna by fans and characters alike.

facts_and_myths.claim: Emma has lower academic test scores than Norman and Ray because of her focus on physical athletics.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Emma consistently achieved full perfect scores of 300 points alongside Norman and Ray on the daily standardized tests.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Emma's original character design was conceived by author Kaiu Shirai as having dark pigtails before illustrator Posuka Demizu gave her wild orange hair.

name: Ray
visual_anchor: Moody vertical 9:16 framing of a dark-haired boy with long bangs covering his left eye, reading a leather-bound book in an orphanage library beside an open matchbox and kerosene can casting long shadows.
core_traits: Pragmatic bookworm orphan bearing identification number 81194 who acts as an undercover spy for Isabella
Possesses infantile amnesia retention, allowing him to remember memories from infancy inside the breeding womb
Spent six years plotting a suicide diversion by setting himself on fire with kerosene to let Emma and Norman escape
Biological son of Grace Field House caretaker Isabella, hummed a lullaby that gave away his true lineage

facts_and_myths.claim: Ray never experienced childhood infantile amnesia, allowing him to remember his mother's lullaby while still a baby.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Due to retaining infantile memories, Ray recognized Isabella's humming melody from before he was born, realizing she was his biological mother.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: The lullaby hummed by Isabella was originally composed by her childhood friend Leslie.

facts_and_myths.claim: Ray was loyal to Mama Isabella and genuinely betrayed his fellow orphans for personal survival.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Ray only acted as Isabella's informant to bargain for tools, camera parts, and information required to engineer the escape of Emma and Norman.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Ray's favorite pastime was reading encyclopedia volumes to absorb engineering knowledge useful for dismantling tracking electronics.

name: Kaguya Shinomiya
visual_anchor: Cinematic vertical 9:16 anime portrait of a high school girl with silky raven-black hair tied in a red ribbon and piercing ruby eyes, resting her chin on her index finger with a smug scheming expression inside a gilded student council room.
core_traits: Vice president of prestigious Shuchiin Academy's student council and heiress to the colossal Shinomiya financial conglomerate
Master of multiple disciplines including archery, traditional arts, and ruthless psychological manipulation
Refuses to confess her romantic feelings first due to the belief that the person who falls in love loses power
Constantly creates elaborate 4D chess schemes to force student council president Miyuki Shirogane to confess

facts_and_myths.claim: Kaguya has multiple distinct mental personas including Ice Kaguya, Bakaguya, and Judge Kaguya represented in internal courtroom debates.
facts_and_myths.explanation: When facing romantic or emotional crises, Kaguya's psyche splits into an internal courtroom where different facets of her personality deliberate over decisions.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Her catchphrase 'O kawaii koto' (How cute) is frequently imagined by Shirogane as a terrifying psychological insult.

facts_and_myths.claim: Kaguya grew up with an abundance of modern gadgets and has advanced technical computer literacy.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Raised in an overly sheltered and traditional patriarchal estate, Kaguya was completely ignorant of smartphones, Twitter, and internet slang until high school.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: She initially believed you had to physically look at someone while sending a text message on an old flip phone.

name: Miyuki Shirogane
visual_anchor: Dynamic vertical 9:16 composition of a blonde high school student with sharp sleepy glare eyes and dark under-eye circles, wearing a black gakuran uniform with gold aiguillette chain, drinking canned coffee amidst piles of test books.
core_traits: Student council president at the elite Shuchiin Academy despite coming from an impoverished, working-class background
Maintains rank number one in school academics through an insane regime of ten hours of daily studying
Suffers from chronic sleep deprivation, severe caffeine dependency, and a naturally sharp, intimidating glare
Completely incompetent at physical sports and singing until retrained through grueling private boot camps by Chika Fujiwara

facts_and_myths.claim: Miyuki Shirogane's intimidating sharp eye expression is caused by chronic sleep deprivation rather than aggression.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Because he studies endlessly late into the night and works multiple part-time jobs, his severe lack of sleep causes his eyes to look perpetually menacing.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: When Shirogane finally got a full eight hours of sleep, his eyes became round and gentle, which horrified Kaguya because he lost his sharp edge.

facts_and_myths.claim: Shirogane is a naturally gifted musical prodigy who performs as the lead vocalist of the academy choir.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Shirogane was tone-deaf and sounded like a dying sea creature when singing until secretary Chika Fujiwara spent weeks training him from scratch.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Chika's traumatic experiences training Shirogane in volleyball, singing, and rap earned her the nickname 'Mother' among fans.

name: Loid Forger
visual_anchor: Stylized vertical 9:16 cinematic espionage frame of a handsome blonde secret agent in a sharp tailored three-piece sage-green suit and red tie, adjusting silencer on a Walther pistol in a shadowy retro European alleyway.
core_traits: Westalis master spy codenamed Twilight who possesses extraordinary combat, deduction, and disguise skills
Adopts the fake identity of a mild-mannered psychiatrist at Berlint General Hospital for Operation Strix
Fabricated an undercover family by adopting telepathic orphan Anya and marrying undercover assassin Yor
Dedicated his life to creating a peaceful world where children never have to cry from the horrors of war

facts_and_myths.claim: Loid Forger chose the profession of psychiatry specifically because it gave him flexible scheduling for undercover espionage operations.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Operating as a clinical psychiatrist at Berlint General Hospital provided him a respectable social cover, flexible appointment hours, and access to city elite.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Loid memorized a dossier of over two hundred Ostania political party members and their quirks in a single night.

facts_and_myths.claim: Loid Forger is fully aware that his adopted daughter Anya can read people's minds telepathically.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Loid has no idea Anya possesses psychic abilities; he frequently assumes her odd behaviors and knowledge are random eccentricities of a quirky child.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Despite being a cold professional spy, Loid has developed a genuine paternal soft spot that constantly stresses his stomach.

name: Anya Forger
visual_anchor: Charming vertical 9:16 portrait of a petite four-year-old girl with bubblegum pink hair and black cone hair ornaments, holding a bag of roasted peanuts and flashing an iconic smug smirk inside an Eden Academy classroom.
core_traits: Escaped experimental lab subject originally known as Test Subject 007 who gained mind-reading telepathy
Adopted by superspy Twilight, she is the only person in the household who knows everyone's secret identities
Obsessed with spy cartoon anime Spy Wars, chimera plush dolls, and snacking on roasted peanuts
Struggles with elementary school academics at elite Eden Academy while trying to earn Stella Stars

facts_and_myths.claim: Anya was the first student in her grade to earn an Eden Academy Stella Star by saving a drowning boy.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Anya used her telepathy to detect a drowning child's mental cries at a community pool, leading to her receiving her first prestigious Stella Star medal.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Her iconic smug face expression became one of the most viral internet anime memes of 2022.

facts_and_myths.claim: Anya's telepathic mind-reading power functions at full strength regardless of lunar phases or crowded environments.
facts_and_myths.explanation: During a new moon, an occurrence known as 'Eclipsing', Anya completely loses her psychic abilities, and large dense crowds give her severe sensory overload.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: She frequently misspells simple words, writing 'peanuts' as 'p-nuts' and thinking the secret police are called the 'woof-woofs'.

name: Yor Forger
visual_anchor: Sensational vertical 9:16 action illustration of an assassin with long raven hair and golden rose headband, clad in a sleek black off-shoulder backless dress, holding two golden stiletto needle daggers surrounded by falling red rose petals.
core_traits: Lethal assassin codenamed Thorn Princess who carries out contract hits for the secret organization Garden
Maintains a cover job as a demure, soft-spoken clerk at Berlint City Hall
Possesses superhuman physical strength capable of kicking speeding cars off course and deflecting tennis balls at supersonic speed
Endearingly terrible at domestic cooking, with her meals frequently poisoning anyone who eats them

facts_and_myths.claim: Yor is virtually immune to lethal poison doses and once drank pufferfish neurotoxin to cure a stiff shoulder.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Having built high toxin tolerance throughout her life, Yor consumed deadly tetrodotoxin poison in a cocktail and merely felt a pleasant tingling numbness in her back.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Her younger brother Yuri Briar is the only human whose digestive system adapted to survive eating her toxic home-cooked meals.

facts_and_myths.claim: Yor agreed to marry Loid because she was secretly hired by Westalis intelligence to monitor him.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Yor entered the sham marriage purely to avoid suspicion from coworkers and the Secret Police, who viewed unmarried twenty-seven-year-old women as potential spies.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Yor becomes completely unhinged and loses all physical restraint after drinking even a tiny sip of wine.

name: Osamu Dazai
visual_anchor: Dramatic vertical 9:16 noir anime frame of a ruffled brown-haired detective wrapped in body bandages beneath a billowing sand-colored trench coat, smirking under soft lamplight as blue glowing energy glyphs ripple from his fingertips.
core_traits: Senior investigator of the Armed Detective Agency and former youngest executive in Port Mafia history
Wields the nullification ability No Longer Human, which deactivates any supernatural power upon physical contact
Brilliant psychological manipulator and strategist who orchestrates events dozens of moves ahead of his enemies
Has a dark obsession with finding a painless method of double suicide while constantly carrying a handbook

facts_and_myths.claim: Osamu Dazai's special ability No Longer Human cannot be copied, amplified, or suppressed by other supernatural powers.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Because his ability permanently nullifies other powers on direct physical contact, Dazai's ability is an ultimate anti-gifted defense that cannot be overridden.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: His character and special ability are named after real-life Japanese literary giant Osamu Dazai and his masterwork novel No Longer Human.

facts_and_myths.claim: Dazai left the Port Mafia because he was defeated and exiled by Port Mafia Boss Ogai Mori.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Dazai deserted the Port Mafia voluntarily following the dying wish of his closest friend Sakunosuke Oda, who urged him to be on the side that saves people.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Despite his goofy, carefree demeanor at the agency, former enemies and allies still tremble when remembering his cold cruelty as Port Mafia's youngest executive.

name: Rimuru Tempest
visual_anchor: Vertical 9:16 cinematic portrait of Rimuru Tempest floating in midair with glowing blue hair, wearing a fur-collared black coat and ornate mask pushed aside, surrounded by swirling blue slime magic and ethereal golden particles.
core_traits: Reincarnated into a fantasy world as a sentient blue slime after dying as an ordinary office worker named Satoru Mikami in modern Tokyo
Possesses the unique skill Predator and the voice of the Great Sage which evolves into the ultimate skill Raphael
Founds and rules the Jura Tempest Federation, uniting monsters and humans into an advanced peaceful civilization
Ascends to become an Awakened Demon Lord and an Octagram member after sacrificing an invading enemy army to resurrect fallen companions

facts_and_myths.claim: Rimuru Tempest is biologically female in both human form and slime form.
facts_and_myths.explanation: As a slime, Rimuru is biologically genderless and lacks reproductive organs, though his human mimicry appearance is modeled after Shizu Izawa.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Rimuru's slime body is made of magicules and can absorb almost unlimited matter without gaining weight.

facts_and_myths.claim: Rimuru becomes an Awakened Demon Lord by harvesting twenty thousand enemy human souls to resurrect his fallen citizens.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Following the brutal assault by the Kingdom of Falmuth that killed Shion and others, Rimuru executed the Megiddo spell to collect souls for his harvest festival evolution.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: His evolution into a True Demon Lord took only several hours but granted immense power boosts to all named subordinates.

name: Ainz Ooal Gown
aliases: Lord of the Great Tomb of Nazarick
visual_anchor: Vertical 9:16 imposing composition of Ainz Ooal Gown sitting upon an ornate obsidian throne in the Great Tomb of Nazarick, an intimidating towering skeleton wearing grand imperial robes and clutching the golden Staff of Ainz Ooal Gown surrounded by eerie red magical flames.
core_traits: Former human salaryman named Suzuki Satoru trapped inside his skeletal avatar when the DMMO-RPG YGGDRASIL shut down
Guildmaster of the Great Tomb of Nazarick worshipped as a supreme being by overwhelmingly loyal heteromorphic floor guardians
Operates in the New World disguised as the adamantite-ranked adventurer Momon while expanding the Sorcerer Kingdom
Master tier-magic caster capable of unleashing tenth-tier magic and Super-Tier spells such as Fallen Down and Iub-Niggurath

facts_and_myths.claim: Ainz Ooal Gown retains his full human emotional spectrum and can experience intense panic without restriction.
facts_and_myths.explanation: His undead lich physiology automatically suppresses strong emotions like panic, rage, or joy with a calming green aura whenever they spike.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: The emotional suppressor aura causes Ainz comedic inner monologues when pretending to be an all-knowing genius in front of Demiurge.

facts_and_myths.claim: The name Ainz Ooal Gown originally belonged to his gaming guild before he took it as his personal name.
facts_and_myths.explanation: His original player character handle was Momonga, but he rebranded himself as Ainz Ooal Gown so other guild members might hear the name and find him.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: The guild strictly required all forty-one members to be working members of society playing non-human monster races.

name: Subaru Natsuki
visual_anchor: Vertical 9:16 dramatic portrait of Subaru Natsuki bruised and wearing his signature white, black, and orange tracksuit standing in a moonlit alleyway of Lugnica, dark miasma shadow hands encircling his chest with glowing purple eyes reflecting desperate determination.
core_traits: Socially isolated modern Japanese teenager suddenly transported to the fantasy Kingdom of Lugnica while walking home from a convenience store
Possesses the mysterious ability Return by Death, which rewinds time to a past checkpoint whenever he dies
Subject to an agonizing curse that prevents him from verbally revealing his time-looping power to anyone without heart-crushing pain or consequences
Serves as the fiercely dedicated, self-proclaimed knight to half-elf royal candidate Emilia

facts_and_myths.claim: Subaru can voluntarily trigger Return by Death whenever he wants by simply imagining a previous checkpoint.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Return by Death activates solely upon his physical demise, and he has zero control over where or when the Witch of Envy sets the checkpoint.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Whenever Subaru attempts to explain his curse, the Witch of Envy physically manifests shadow hands to grasp his heart.

facts_and_myths.claim: Subaru was transported to Lugnica carrying only a convenience store plastic bag containing snacks and a flip phone.
facts_and_myths.explanation: He entered the fantasy realm with no weapons or magical tools, holding instant ramen, chips, and a cellphone that quickly ran out of battery.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: He used the ringtone from his flip phone as a timer to orchestrate the ambush against the terrifying White Whale.

name: Emilia
visual_anchor: Vertical 9:16 enchanting portrait of Emilia with long silver hair and amethyst-purple eyes, dressed in an elegant white and lavender fantasy gown, conjuring sharp crystalline ice shards around her while her spirit cat Puck rests on her shoulder.
core_traits: Silver-haired half-elf spirit arts user and one of five royal candidates competing for the throne of the Kingdom of Lugnica
Often discriminated against and feared because of her striking physical resemblance to the catastrophic Witch of Envy, Satella
Accompanied by the Great Spirit of Fire Puck, who acts as her protective father figure in the form of a small floating cat
Wields powerful ice magic and spirit pacts, notably freezing the Great Elior Forest in her tragic childhood past

facts_and_myths.claim: Emilia and the dreaded Witch of Envy Satella are confirmed to be the exact same person.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Satella is a distinct historical entity who was sealed four centuries prior, though Emilia shares identical appearance and mysterious ties to her.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Emilia introduced herself to Subaru using Satella as an alias during their initial meeting to deliberately scare him away for his safety.

facts_and_myths.claim: Emilia spent nearly a century frozen inside a magical ice block before being awakened by Puck.
facts_and_myths.explanation: After losing control of her immense magical powers during Pandora's attack on the Elior Forest, Emilia encased the entire forest and herself in unmelting ice for roughly a century.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Because of her long slumber, Emilia has the physical body and mental innocence of a teenager despite chronologically living over a hundred years.

name: Rem
visual_anchor: Vertical 9:16 dynamic action shot of Rem in her black and white maid dress swinging a massive spiky metal morningstar on a chain, a glowing white horn protruding from her forehead with glowing blue eyes in full demon frenzy against a dark misty forest.
core_traits: Blue-haired twin maid serving at the Roswaal L. Mathers estate alongside her identical pink-haired sister Ram
Belongs to the powerful Oni clan and possesses a single magical horn that unleashes ferocious combat strength and mana control
Initially suspicious and murderous toward Subaru due to his lingering Witch scent, later falling deeply and devotedly in love with him
Fell into a comatose state after her existence and memories were devoured by the Archbishop of Gluttony, Ley Batenkaitos

facts_and_myths.claim: Rem was born with two horns like all traditional members of the Oni demon clan.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Because Rem and Ram were born as twins, each inherited only a single horn, violating the Oni clan tradition and nearly resulting in their infanticide.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Ram was considered a prodigious genius possessing unmatched power until her single horn was severed by the Witch Cult.

facts_and_myths.claim: Rem confessed her love to Subaru and offered to run away with him to live in a faraway country.
facts_and_myths.explanation: In the renowned Episode 18 'From Zero', Rem delivered an impassioned emotional confession that restored Subaru's broken resolve after he suggested fleeing Lugnica.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: An official light novel spin-off called Re:IF explores an alternate timeline where Subaru accepts Rem's proposal and they raise two children together.

name: Kazuma Sato
visual_anchor: Vertical 9:16 comedic action portrait of Kazuma Sato wearing a green hooded cloak over simple tunic armor, holding up a stolen pair of frilly panties with a smug, mischievous grin while preparing to cast Create Water and Freeze in a fantasy town square.
core_traits: Shut-in Japanese teenager who died of shock after mistaking a slow-moving farm tractor for a speeding truck while trying to save a girl
Reincarnated into the fantasy world of Axel after dragging the arrogant Water Goddess Aqua with him as his chosen cheat item
Classified as an Adventurer class, the lowest generalist tier, yet compensates through extraordinary high luck, cunning schemes, and versatile low-tier skills
Leads an infamously dysfunctional party consisting of an incompetent goddess, a single-shot explosion fanatic, and a masochistic crusader

facts_and_myths.claim: Kazuma died heroically after taking the full kinetic impact of a speeding heavy tractor-trailer.
facts_and_myths.explanation: The tractor was moving at walking speed and stopped harmlessly; Kazuma actually died from acute panic-induced heart failure and wet himself in hospital.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: The hospital doctors and Kazuma's own family laughed hysterically upon discovering the embarrassing medical cause of his death.

facts_and_myths.claim: Kazuma defeated high-ranking Demon King generals using basic low-tier utility spells and high luck.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Kazuma frequently combines beginner skills like Steal, Create Water, Freeze, and Lurk with explosive magic to outsmart powerful foes like Beldia and Vanir.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: His luck stat is second only to the Goddess of Luck, Eris, which allows him to dominate fantasy gambling tables.

name: Aqua
visual_anchor: Vertical 9:16 vibrant full-body shot of Aqua with waist-length bright blue hair and matching blue eyes, wearing her ornate sleeveless divine dress and transparent water-loop hagoromo scarf, crying hysterically while desperately casting God Blow against a giant charging toad.
core_traits: Water goddess who originally guided deceased Japanese souls into the afterlife before being dragged to the mortal world by Kazuma Sato
Possesses maximum archpriest stats from level one, boasting unlimited divine mana, party purification, and high-tier party revival spells
Severely hindered by zero intelligence growth and terrible luck, constantly running up massive brewery debts and causing catastrophic disasters
Worshipped fervently by the eccentric and aggressively pushy religious cult known as the Axis Church

facts_and_myths.claim: Aqua's intelligence stat can be upgraded if she completes high-level quests and earns skill points.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Her initial Adventurer Guild registration card revealed that her intelligence and luck stats were fundamentally capped at below average and can never increase.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Despite her abysmal intelligence, she can master high-level construction, masonry, and party tricks within seconds.

facts_and_myths.claim: Aqua naturally purifies any water or liquid she touches into pure, sterile fresh water.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Her divine physical contact instantly cleanses contaminated water, hot springs, and even expensive alcoholic drinks into regular plain drinking water.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: She nearly ruined Axel's hot spring tourism industry by accidentally purifying the mineral waters into tap water.

name: Megumin
visual_anchor: Vertical 9:16 epic dramatic shot of Megumin posing theatrically in her red witch dress, oversized pointed wizard hat, and black eyepatch, pointing her carved wooden staff forward as a colossal blinding scarlet explosion mushrooms across the horizon behind her.
core_traits: Precocious Arch Mage belonging to the genetically engineered, chuunibyou-prone Crimson Demon clan characterized by glowing red eyes
Fanatically refuses to learn any magical spells other than Explosion, investing all earned skill points exclusively into maximizing its destructive yield
Completely exhausts her entire mana supply after casting a single Explosion spell, collapsing face-first into total paralysis
Carries an eccentric black cat familiar named Chomusuke, who is secretly the half-portion of dark goddess Wolbach

facts_and_myths.claim: Megumin wears an eyepatch over her left eye to seal away an uncontrollable demonic dark power.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Her eyepatch is purely a theatrical fashion accessory worn for dramatic chuunibyou style, and her eyesight is perfectly normal.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: She admitted to Kazuma that she just thinks the eyepatch looks extremely cool and intimidating.

facts_and_myths.claim: Megumin demands to cast one Explosion spell every single day or she physically feels sick.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Her body and mana pool have become so accustomed to daily discharge that she experiences severe agitation and discomfort if she misses a day.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Her daily practice on an abandoned castle repeatedly infuriated the Dullahan general Beldia, triggering a town invasion.

name: Kirito
visual_anchor: Vertical 9:16 high-intensity battle visual of Kirito in his iconic black trench coat dual-wielding the pitch-black Elucidator and teal-glowing Dark Repulser, executing the rapid Starburst Stream sword skill amidst shattering blue digital glass and neon light streaks.
core_traits: Elite solo player trapped inside the deadly VRMMORPG Sword Art Online, where in-game death caused immediate real-world brain death
Labeled a Beater (Beta Tester and Cheater) by fellow players after taking the blame to protect other testers from public resentment
Unlocks the unique Dual Blades skill for possessing the fastest reaction speed in the entire game
Strikes the final blow to defeat game creator Akihiko Kayaba (Heathcliff) on Floor 75, freeing thousands of surviving players

facts_and_myths.claim: Kirito learned the Dual Blades unique skill by finding a secret hidden dungeon chest on Floor 50.
facts_and_myths.explanation: The Dual Blades skill was automatically awarded by the Cardinal System to the player possessing the fastest reaction time among all trapped players.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Kirito hid the Dual Blades skill in his status menu for nearly a year to avoid unwanted attention and envy from rival guilds.

facts_and_myths.claim: Kirito's real-world body lost significant muscle mass and required extensive physical therapy after waking from SAO.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Being comatose and bedridden in a hospital for two straight years caused severe muscle atrophy, making him barely able to stand upon logging out.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Immediately after waking up in the hospital bed, Kirito disconnected his IV drip and used a metal pole as a cane to search for Asuna.

name: Asuna Yuuki
visual_anchor: Vertical 9:16 dynamic portrait of Asuna Yuuki in her white and crimson Knights of the Blood Oath uniform, flowing chestnut-brown hair whipping in the wind as she lunges forward thrusting her elegant silver rapier Lambent Light surrounded by blinding golden sonic trails.
core_traits: Top-tier frontline combatant and fiercely capable Vice Commander of the leading clearing guild Knights of the Blood Oath in Sword Art Online
Earned the famous nickname The Flash for her blindingly fast rapier sword skills, wielding the mastercrafted rapier Lambent Light
Falls in love with solo swordsman Kirito, marrying him in-game and adopting the AI guidance program Yui as their surrogate daughter
Dives into the Underworld using the superuser account Goddess of Creation Stacia to rescue Kirito during the Alicization War

facts_and_myths.claim: Asuna was an experienced hardcore PC gamer before purchasing and logging into the NerveGear.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Asuna was an elite academic student from a strict wealthy family who had never touched video games before impulsively borrowing her brother's NerveGear.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: In the first month of SAO, Asuna hid in an inn room terrified of dying until she resolved to fight desperately rather than wither away.

facts_and_myths.claim: Asuna maxed out the Cooking skill in SAO despite the game focusing almost entirely on sword combat.
facts_and_myths.explanation: She dedicated hours of downtime to leveling up Cooking to complete mastery, allowing her to prepare delicious real-tasting dishes like Ragout Rabbit stew.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Her culinary mastery was so legendary that even rare ingredient brokers came to her to cook high-tier game items.

name: Spike Spiegel
visual_anchor: Cinematic vertical 9:16 composition of a lean, disheveled bounty hunter with messy dark green hair, wearing a loose navy blue leisure suit, cigarette between his lips, standing in a dimly lit neon alleyway with rain reflections, drawing a Jericho 941 pistol with fluid martial arts posture.
core_traits: Languid and cynical bounty hunter who travels across the solar system aboard a converted fishing trawler spaceship named the Bebop
Practitioner of Jeet Kune Do martial arts who conceals a cybernetic prosthetic right eye that sees only the past
Former operative of the Red Dragon Crime Syndicate whose past catches up with him through his nemesis Vicious and lost love Julia
Famous for his nonchalant demeanor and final parting phrase 'Bang' delivered with a finger gun gesture

facts_and_myths.claim: Spike Spiegel's artificial right eye gives him superhuman targeting accuracy and cybernetic zoom capabilities in combat.
facts_and_myths.explanation: His cybernetic eye is merely a medical prosthetic replacement with no combat enhancements, though Spike metaphorically remarks that one eye sees the present while the other sees the past.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Spike lost his original eye in an unspecified incident during his days in the Red Dragon Syndicate.

facts_and_myths.claim: Director Shinichiro Watanabe modeled Spike Spiegel's visual appearance and movements on martial artist Bruce Lee and actor Yusaku Matsuda.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Watanabe explicitly based Spike's fluid fighting style on Bruce Lee's Jeet Kune Do philosophy and his iconic hairstyle and trench coat look on Yusaku Matsuda from Tantei Monogatari.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: The spaceship Swordfish II piloted by Spike was originally a high-speed racing craft before being refitted with heavy weaponry.

name: Faye Valentine
visual_anchor: Dramatic vertical 9:16 portrait of a glamorous purple-haired bounty hunter in a bright yellow crop top and shorts, leaning against the cockpit of her red Redline pod craft, holding a deck of playing cards and a semi-automatic handgun amid the golden sands of a Martian spaceport.
core_traits: Amnesiac bounty hunter and gambler who awakened from 54 years of cryogenic sleep to find herself saddled with an astronomical debt
Member of the Bebop crew who pilots the heavily customized zipcraft named the Red Harrier
Discovered a Betamax cassette recorded by her younger self that revealed her lost childhood memories in Singapore
Distinguished by her violet hair, yellow outfit, and cynical opportunism concealing a deep yearning for family

facts_and_myths.claim: Faye Valentine chose her surname because she was cryogenically frozen on Valentine's Day.
facts_and_myths.explanation: The doctor who awakened Faye from cryogenic suspension, Doctor Baccus, gave her the surname Valentine on a whim because she had complete amnesia and could not remember her real name.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Her actual family name and lineage remain unknown throughout the entire series.

facts_and_myths.claim: Faye Valentine was born in 1994, making her chronologically older than Jet Black and Spike Spiegel.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Although she appears to be 23 years old due to cryogenic stasis after a spacecraft accident, she was born in 1994 and awakened in 2068, making her chronologically 77 years old.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Her cryogenic freezing bill amounted to an astonishing 300,028,000 woolongs.

name: Jet Black
visual_anchor: Atmospheric vertical 9:16 composition of a burly, bearded spaceship captain with a metallic cybernetic arm and a facial scar, delicately tending to miniature bonsai trees inside the cluttered greenhouse workshop of a vintage interplanetary vessel.
core_traits: Former detective of the Inter Solar System Police (ISSP) who turned to bounty hunting after being betrayed by his corrupt partner
Owner and captain of the Bebop converted fishing trawler and pilot of the utility craft Hammerhead
Possesses a heavy cybernetic prosthetic left arm, distinctive facial scar, and a passionate hobby of pruning bonsai trees
Serves as the pragmatic, fatherly anchor and mechanic for the eccentric crew of bounty hunters

facts_and_myths.claim: Jet Black's mechanical arm was severed during an ISSP shootout and replaced against his will by corrupt superiors.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Jet chose a mechanical prosthetic over an organic cellular graft deliberately, keeping the robotic limb as a permanent physical reminder of the betrayal he suffered on Ganymede.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: The cybernetic arm was cheap and obsolete, which Jet preferred because he could repair it himself.

facts_and_myths.claim: Jet Black was nicknamed 'The Black Dog' by his police peers because once he bit into a criminal case, he never let go.
facts_and_myths.explanation: His ISSP moniker reflected his relentless tenacity and refusal to abandon investigations until the guilty party was brought to justice.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Jet loves delta blues and jazz music, especially the work of Charlie Parker.

name: Motoko Kusanagi
visual_anchor: Striking vertical 9:16 visual of an athletic female cyborg commander with violet-blue cropped hair and crimson eyes, perched atop a rain-soaked Tokyo skyscraper at night, activating active thermo-optical camouflage while holding an assault rifle.
core_traits: Field commander of Section 9, a covert counter-terrorist intelligence agency operating in futuristic New Port City
Full-body cybernetic prosthetic user whose remaining human component is her biological brain and ghost soul
Master hacker and tactician who merges her consciousness with the autonomous AI entity known as the Puppet Master
Known by the operational title 'The Major' due to her former military background

facts_and_myths.claim: Motoko Kusanagi's military rank of Major is an active commission in the Japanese Armed Forces during the events of Section 9.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Section 9 is a civilian public security intelligence apparatus under the Ministry of Home Affairs; Kusanagi retired from the military, and 'Major' is an enduring honorary nickname used by colleagues.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Only her close partner Batou and Chief Aramaki regularly refer to her as Major in daily operations.

facts_and_myths.claim: Motoko Kusanagi became a full-body cyborg in early childhood following a catastrophic airplane crash.
facts_and_myths.explanation: A commercial aircraft disaster left her critically injured as a young child, requiring her brain to be transferred into an experimental pediatric prosthetic body to save her life.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Her hobby of deep-sea scuba diving is dangerous because her heavy prosthetic body would sink like stone if cybernetic motors failed.

name: Shinji Ikari
visual_anchor: Melancholy vertical 9:16 shot of a slender teenage boy with dark hair and blue eyes, wearing a white short-sleeve shirt and blue trousers, sitting with his knees curled to his chest inside the glowing orange LCL fluid of a giant bio-mechanical cockpit.
core_traits: Reluctant teenage pilot designated as the Third Child of the bio-mechanical giant Evangelion Unit-01
Summoned to Tokyo-3 by his estranged father Gendo Ikari to defend humanity against invading extraterrestrial Angels
Frequently listens to a portable cassette tape player on tracks 25 and 26 to withdraw from social interaction
Struggles with the Hedgehog's Dilemma, deep existential dread, and the crushing burden of the Human Instrumentality Project
