facts_and_myths.claim: Shinji Ikari was chosen to pilot Evangelion Unit-01 because of exceptional military aptitude scores and academic testing.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Shinji was chosen because Unit-01 harbors the soul of his deceased mother, Yui Ikari, making Shinji uniquely compatible to synchronize with the bio-mechanical entity.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: His father Gendo deliberately designed the sync requirements around maternal soul bonding.

facts_and_myths.claim: Shinji Ikari is an accomplished cellist who has practiced the instrument since the age of five.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Shinji plays the cello skillfully, though he confesses he only continued practicing because nobody ever told him to stop.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: His musical rhythm and cello discipline later enable him to synchronize twin attacks with Asuka against the Angel Israfel.

name: Rei Ayanami
visual_anchor: Ethereal vertical 9:16 composition of an enigmatic pale teenage girl with short pale blue hair and piercing red eyes, wrapped in medical bandages and a white plugsuit, standing silently before a giant crimson moon in a sterile underground laboratory.
core_traits: Stoic and enigmatic pilot designated as the First Child of Evangelion Unit-00 at NERV
Genetic clone created from the salvaged biological matter of Yui Ikari infused with the soul of the Angel Lilith
Exhibits profound emotional detachment and quiet loyalty to NERV commander Gendo Ikari
Key catalyst in the Human Instrumentality Project whose soul initiates Third Impact

facts_and_myths.claim: Rei Ayanami is an ordinary human orphan adopted by Gendo Ikari after a military catastrophe.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Rei is an artificial clone grown in the Central Dogma terminal facility from salvaged DNA of Shinji's mother Yui Ikari and soul remnants of Lilith, with multiple backup replacement bodies stored in dummy tanks.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Three distinct incarnations of Rei appear across the main original television series.

facts_and_myths.claim: Director Hideaki Anno chose the surname Ayanami from an Imperial Japanese Navy Fubuki-class destroyer.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Anno named virtually all principal characters in Evangelion after historical naval warships, with Ayanami paying homage to the World War II destroyer.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Her given name Rei is a pun on the Japanese character for zero, reflecting her assignment to Unit-00.

name: Asuka Langley Soryu
visual_anchor: Vibrant vertical 9:16 portrait of a fiery red-haired teenage pilot in a sleek crimson plugsuit with twin interface headsets, striking an arrogant hands-on-hips pose on the deck of an aircraft carrier surrounded by crashing ocean waves.
core_traits: Proud and fiercely competitive prodigy designated as the Second Child and pilot of Evangelion Unit-02
Earned a university degree in Germany at the age of fourteen before transferring to NERV Tokyo-3
Conceals severe childhood trauma beneath an arrogant exterior and the catchphrase 'Anta baka?' ('What are you, stupid?')
Engages in a legendary and tragic last stand against the mass-produced Evangelion units in The End of Evangelion

facts_and_myths.claim: Asuka's mother committed suicide after being physically attacked and injured by an Angel.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Her mother, Kyoko Zeppelin Soryu, suffered severe mental breakdown and psychosis after a failed Evangelion synchronization experiment that absorbed part of her soul, later leading to suicide.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Kyoko's maternal soul remnant remained bound inside Unit-02, which Asuka awakens during her final battle.

facts_and_myths.claim: Asuka's character name combines names from two historical World War II aircraft carriers: Soryu and Langley.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Director Hideaki Anno derived her surname Soryu from the Imperial Japanese Navy aircraft carrier, and Langley from the United States Navy aircraft carrier USS Langley.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: In the Rebuild of Evangelion film tetralogy, her surname was altered from Soryu to Shikinami.

name: Simon the Digger
visual_anchor: Epic vertical 9:16 visual of a determined spiky blue-haired mecha pilot wearing a flowing black coat with red flame trims and star-shaped sunglasses, holding a glowing golden core drill amulet pointed defiantly upward toward cosmic galaxies.
core_traits: Subterranean excavation boy who unearths a tiny robot head named Lagann and a mysterious spiral-shaped core drill
Co-founds Team Gurren alongside his sworn spiritual brother Kamina to break through to the surface world
Channels near-infinite Spiral Power to pilot the universe-shattering super robot Tengen Toppa Gurren Lagann
Evolves from a timid, insecure youth into the triumphant supreme commander of humanity against the Anti-Spirals

facts_and_myths.claim: Simon's mecha Gurren Lagann operates on nuclear fusion engines discovered in underground human ruins.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Gurren Lagann runs entirely on Spiral Power, the evolutionary life-energy and willpower produced by living beings with DNA.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: The more courage and resolve Simon exhibits, the larger and more reality-bending Gurren Lagann becomes.

facts_and_myths.claim: Simon's signature golden drill necklace is named the Core Drill and serves as the ignition key for Lagann.
facts_and_myths.explanation: The Core Drill focuses Simon's latent Spiral Power, activating Lagann and allowing it to assimilate other mechanical Gunmen through brute force.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Simon was only 14 years old when he first broke through the ceiling of Giha Village.

name: Kamina
visual_anchor: Heroic vertical 9:16 shot of a tall, muscular blue-haired warrior wearing pointed orange sunglasses and a flowing red cape with a flaming skull insignia, holding an oversized nodachi katana sword raised toward the open sky.
core_traits: Charismatic and fearless founder of Team Gurren who refuses to accept the subterranean confinement of humanity
Known for his pointed red sunglasses, flaming skull cape, and wielding a massive nodachi katana
Original pilot of the Gunmen mecha Gurren who combines with Simon's Lagann to form Gurren Lagann
Famous for inspiring Simon with the timeless motto: 'Believe in the you who believes in yourself'

facts_and_myths.claim: Kamina survives the decisive assault on the Beastman fortress Dai-Gunzan and leads Team Dai-Gurren to space.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Kamina dies tragically from combat wounds in episode 8 after defeating Thymilph, leaving Simon to carry on his fiery will and leadership.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Kamina's death sent shockwaves through the anime community and inspired an iconic memorial statue in the series.

facts_and_myths.claim: Kamina stole his signature Gunmen Gurren directly from a Beastman scout by knocking the pilot out with bare fists.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Kamina defeated the Beastman pilot through sheer determination and hijacked the machine, painting his own insignia over it.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Kamina had visited the surface world once as a small boy with his father before returning underground.

name: Vash the Stampede
aliases: The Sixty Billion Double Dollar Man
visual_anchor: Dynamic vertical 9:16 composition of a tall, blonde gunslinger with spiky hair and yellow round sunglasses, wearing a torn sweeping red trench coat and leather boots, spinning a silver custom six-shot revolver across a sun-scorched desert wasteland.
core_traits: Legendary wandering gunman with a sixty-billion double-dollar bounty on his head known as The Humanoid Typhoon
Strict pacifist who refuses to take any human life despite traveling with a silver .45 caliber custom revolver
Artificial inter-dimensional being known as an independent Plant, equipped with an integrated Angel Arm superweapon
Hounded across the desert planet of No Man's Land by insurance agents Meryl Stryfe and Milly Thompson

facts_and_myths.claim: Vash intentionally annihilated the city of July to demonstrate his supreme combat power to humanity.
facts_and_myths.explanation: The destruction of July was an uncontrollable catastrophe triggered against his will when his twin brother Knives forcefully activated Vash's Angel Arm.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Vash suffers deep psychological trauma and guilt over July despite having had no conscious control over the blast.

facts_and_myths.claim: Vash the Stampede is over one hundred years old despite appearing as a young man in his twenties.
facts_and_myths.explanation: As an engineered biological Plant entity created for the SEEDS colony ships, Vash ages far slower than normal humans.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Vash's favorite food in the entire universe is sweet donuts, which he devours by the dozen.

name: Frieren
visual_anchor: Cinematic vertical 9:16 composition of the elven mage Frieren standing on a misty grassy hill at sunset, holding her wooden staff topped with a crescent ring, her long twin white pigtails swaying in the wind as mystical blue mana particles swirl around her green-trimmed white robe.
core_traits: Ancient elven mage who was a core member of the Hero Party that defeated the Demon King after a ten-year adventure
Apprentice to the legendary great human mage Flamme and master of the young human mage Fern
Notorious for suppressing her vast mana output constantly to bait and deceive demon foes, earning her the title 'Frieren the Slayer'
Obsessed with collecting mundane and eccentric spells, such as turning sweet grapes sour or creating a field of blue moon flowers

facts_and_myths.claim: Frieren travels north toward the land of Ende solely to find the mythical ancient grimoire of omnipotent magic.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Her true journey to Aureole in the north is to speak once again with her deceased comrade Himmel the Hero, whom she regrets not getting to know better during his lifetime.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Her peculiar passion for exploring dungeons often leads her into getting swallowed headfirst by mimic treasure chests despite knowing there is a 99 percent chance it is a trap.

facts_and_myths.claim: Frieren has spent more than a thousand years perpetually restricting her visible mana to a fraction of its true scale.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Under Flamme's guidance, she learned to suppress her mana so flawlessly that demons, who judge combat strength purely by aura, consistently underestimate her until it is too late.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: In the German language, the name 'Frieren' translates directly to 'to freeze' or 'to feel cold', echoing her detached demeanor.

name: Fern
visual_anchor: Dramatic vertical 9:16 portrait of Fern casting Zoltraak magic from her slender wooden staff, dark purple hair billowing dramatically in the magical wind, focused violet eyes glowing beneath dark bangs, set against a crumbling ancient stone fortress under a twilight sky.
core_traits: Human prodigy mage orphaned in the Southern Lands who was raised by corrupt priest Heiter and apprenticed to Frieren
Youngest person to pass the rigorous First-Class Mage certification exam under Continental Magic Association founder Serie
Specializes in rapid-fire Zoltraak ordinary offensive magic and extraordinary mana concealment that outpaces high-ranking demons
Acts as the responsible, stern maternal figure of the traveling party, managing expenses and waking her sluggish master every morning

facts_and_myths.claim: Fern's combat style relies almost exclusively on the basic ordinary offensive spell Zoltraak rather than flamboyant high-tier magic.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Frieren trained Fern to master casting speed, accuracy, and mana conservation with Zoltraak, arguing that simple magic cast faster than an opponent's defense is the ultimate lethal weapon.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Fern's signature expression is a puffed-up pout whenever Stark or Frieren acts childish or thoughtless.

facts_and_myths.claim: Serie rejected Fern from becoming a First-Class Mage because Fern refused to accept a legendary spell as a reward.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Serie immediately recognized Fern's terrifying talent and passed her on the spot after Fern noticed Serie's own mana instability, though Fern did choose a mundane spell that cleans clothing as her reward.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: The name 'Fern' means 'far' or 'distant' in German, symbolizing her steady, far-reaching magical trajectory.

name: Stark
visual_anchor: Intense vertical 9:16 action shot of the warrior Stark cleaving a massive boulder with his heavy red-bladed battleaxe, glowing sparks and flying debris framing his spiky red hair and battle-scared face, wearing a dark sleeveless vest over a white tunic in a rugged mountainous canyon.
core_traits: Skilled young human warrior trained by the dwarven master fighter Eisen of the legendary Hero Party
Wields a heavy double-edged battleaxe with enough concussive force to slice sheer cliff faces and slay a solar dragon in a single blow
Despite incredible physical endurance and destructive power, he is an admitted coward whose hands shake uncontrollably before every duel
Serves as the vanguard protector for Frieren and Fern on their northern voyage toward Aureole

facts_and_myths.claim: Stark fled his hometown during a monster raid out of pure malice and selfishness while leaving his family behind.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Stark's older brother Stoltz, the only person who showed him warmth and saw his potential, ordered Stark to escape and survive because Stoltz knew Stark would one day become a great warrior.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Stark loves eating massive jumbo berry sundaes, a treat Eisen traditionally ordered for apprentices who tried their hardest.

facts_and_myths.claim: Eisen struck Stark and caused Stark to flee during their training because Eisen was secretly terrified of the boy's monstrous strength.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Eisen confessed to Frieren that he reflexively struck Stark because he saw such immense latent martial talent in the boy that it genuinely frightened the veteran dwarf warrior.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: In German, the name 'Stark' literally translates to 'strong', reflecting his immense physical fortitude.

name: Himmel
visual_anchor: Inspiring vertical 9:16 memorial shot of the youthful hero Himmel pointing a radiant steel sword toward the sunrise, light blue hair fluttering beside a flowing white traveler cloak, surrounded by blooming blue moon flowers atop a cobblestone pedestal in a grand royal capital.
core_traits: Legendary human hero and swordsman who led the party that successfully defeated the Demon King after a decade-long quest
Distinctive for his blue hair, mole under his left eye, dashing charisma, and shameless fondness for erecting bronze statues of himself
Failed to pull the mythical divine Hero Blade from its stone pedestal, choosing instead to defeat evil with an ordinary replica sword
His death from old age fifty years after his grand victory served as the emotional catalyst for Frieren's new journey of understanding

facts_and_myths.claim: Himmel never actually wielded the authentic sacred sword intended for the prophesied legendary hero.
facts_and_myths.explanation: When the sacred sword stuck in the stone rejected him, Himmel resolved that he did not need destiny or a prophecy to save humanity, defeating the Demon King with a standard forged blade.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: He insisted on commissioning countless statues across towns in exaggerated heroic poses so Frieren would never feel lonely when she outlived everyone.

facts_and_myths.claim: Himmel confessed his romantic love directly to Frieren and proposed marriage before the party disbanded.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Himmel deeply loved Frieren and gave her a ring engraved with the mirrored lotus motif symbolizing eternal love, but he never explicitly confessed his feelings, aware of their disparate lifespans.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: The name 'Himmel' means 'sky' or 'heaven' in German, complementing his blue hair and soaring ideals.

name: Naofumi Iwatani
visual_anchor: Moody vertical 9:16 portrait of Naofumi Iwatani crouching with his glowing green Barbarian Armor and Wrath Shield crackling with ominous black fire, intense dark scowl, spiked black hair, accompanied by ethereal green shield barrier auras on a ruined fantasy battlefield.
core_traits: University student summoned from modern Japan into the fantasy realm of Melromarc as one of the Four Cardinal Heroes
Armed exclusively with a legendary defensive shield that prevents him from wielding swords, spears, bows, or offensive blades
Turned bitter, cynical, and pragmatic after being falsely accused of treason and sexual assault by Princess Malty Melromarc
Raised and bonded deeply with the demi-human raccoon slave Raphtalia and the giant avian filolial bird Filo

facts_and_myths.claim: Naofumi cannot perform any offensive actions or deal any combat damage under any circumstances because of his shield restriction.
facts_and_myths.explanation: While restricted from equipping offensive weapons, Naofumi unlocks cursed series abilities like the Shield of Wrath, Iron Maiden, and Blood Sacrifice to unleash devastating counterattacks.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: He is a remarkably skilled cook and merchant, funding his campaign across Melromarc by selling handcrafted medicine and accessories.

facts_and_myths.claim: Naofumi has complete physical immunity to motion sickness and alcohol toxicity in the fantasy world.
facts_and_myths.explanation: His high constitution and shield passive bonuses make him completely immune to alcohol, allowing him to snack on alcoholic Lucor fruits that cause adult soldiers to pass out immediately.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: His original favorite hobby back in Japan was reading light novels and playing management simulation games.

name: Darkness
visual_anchor: Dynamic vertical 9:16 framing of the blonde crusader Darkness clad in polished white and gold plate armor, holding an oversized two-handed broadsword awkwardly, flushed ecstatic blushing expression amidst exploding cabbages and monster dust clouds in an open fantasy meadow.
core_traits: Noble crusader and paladin in Kazuma Sato's adventuring party in the comedic fantasy kingdom of Belzerg
Secretly the high-born noble heiress Dustiness Ford Lalatina, who despises being called by her aristocratic birth name
Possesses immense physical endurance and monstrous tanking durability, but has abysmal accuracy and cannot hit any target with her sword
Extreme masochist who openly daydreams about suffering humiliating defeats, monster beatings, and verbal degradation by enemies

facts_and_myths.claim: Darkness possesses maxed-out physical defense and strength stats that surpass high-ranking warriors despite her comedic uselessness.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Her build is completely specialized into defensive stamina, allowing her to survive point-blank explosions, hydra breath, and vanir possession without permanent injury.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: When possessed by the greater demon Vanir, her physical body was able to land lethal strikes because Vanir took over her motor functions.

facts_and_myths.claim: Darkness abandoned her noble family completely and had all of her inheritance stripped away by the King.
facts_and_myths.explanation: She remains deeply devoted to her ailing father Lord Ignis Dustiness and frequently uses her family prestige and funds to bail Kazuma's party out of legal disasters.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: She gets intensely flustered and embarrassed whenever anyone uses her sweet real name Lalatina in public.

name: Albedo
visual_anchor: Regal vertical 9:16 shot of Albedo standing elegantly in the Throne Room of the Great Tomb of Nazarick, magnificent black-feathered wings unfurling from her waist, curved ram horns emerging from sleek black hair, wearing an immaculate white goddess gown with a golden spider necklace.
core_traits: Overseer of the Floor Guardians and administrative second-in-command of the Great Tomb of Nazarick in the New World
Succubus demon created by Supreme Being Tabula Smaragdina, armed with the legendary black full plate armor Hermes Trismegistus
Possesses near-impenetrable defensive capabilities, designed as the ultimate tank able to absorb multiple super-tier spells without injury
Fiercely and obsessively infatuated with Ainz Ooal Gown due to a last-second rewrite of her character description settings

facts_and_myths.claim: Albedo's undying romantic devotion to Momonga was not part of her original design backstory.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Her creator Tabula Smaragdina initially wrote her as a promiscuous succubus, but Momonga altered her bio text to 'she is deeply in love with Momonga' seconds before Yggdrasil server shutdown.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Despite being created as a succubus, her romantic obsession with Ainz has kept her a pure virgin, meaning she cannot summon her Bicorn mount.

facts_and_myths.claim: Albedo reveres all 41 Supreme Beings of Ainz Ooal Gown equally and hopes to reunite with every former player.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Albedo secretly resents the other 40 guild members for abandoning Nazarick and Momonga, even forming a covert death squad intended to assassinate any other Supreme Being they discover.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Her name 'Albedo' refers to the second stage of the magnum opus in classical alchemy, representing purification and whitening.

name: Ram
visual_anchor: Sharp vertical 9:16 composition of the pink-haired twin maid Ram balancing a silver tea tray in a lavish Roswaal mansion hallway, piercing rose-red eyes glaring with sharp disdain, delicate frilled black-and-white uniform accentuating her petite silhouette against stained-glass sunlight.
core_traits: Twin sister of Rem and senior head maid serving at the Roswaal L. Mathers estate in the Kingdom of Lugnica
Revered in her youth as a once-in-a-millennium Oni prodigy before her single horn was severed by the Witch Cult during a village massacre
Maintains a sharp-tongued, arrogant, and dismissive exterior, regularly calling Subaru Natsuki 'Barusu' while secretly caring for those close to her
Harbors absolute emotional loyalty and affection for Margrave Roswaal, who replenishes her mana deficit daily

facts_and_myths.claim: Ram is a master chef and housekeeper who handles all the intricate cooking and laundry across the Roswaal estate.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Ram is notoriously awful at domestic chores and cooking, leaving virtually all actual housework and culinary masterpieces to her younger twin sister Rem while proudly boasting about peeling steamed potatoes.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Subaru often nicknames her 'the pink deadweight' when observing her hilarious lack of domestic competence compared to Rem.

facts_and_myths.claim: Ram would have been executed at birth by her own clan elders if Rem had not been born beside her.
facts_and_myths.explanation: The Oni clan considered twins cursed because they share a single horn each instead of two, but baby Ram unleashed such staggering magical power that the elders spared both sisters in awe.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Without her horn, Ram's body suffers severe chronic fatigue and mana exhaustion if she overuses her wind magic Fura.

name: Misato Katsuragi
visual_anchor: Atmospheric vertical 9:16 portrait of Operations Director Misato Katsuragi leaning against a tactical control console in NERV Command, crimson beret and red leather jacket over a black dress, silver cross pendant resting on her chest, purple hair illuminated by holographic emergency tactical displays.
core_traits: Operations Director and tactical commander at special agency NERV responsible for commanding Evangelion pilot operations against the Angels
Sole survivor of the Antarctic Second Impact research expedition led by her estranged father Dr. Katsuragi
Acts as legal guardian and surrogate parent to Eva pilots Shinji Ikari and Asuka Langley Soryu in her chaotic Tokyo-3 apartment
Wears an iconic silver Greek cross pendant around her neck and harbors a passionate love for Yebisu beer and her warm-water pet penguin Pen Pen

facts_and_myths.claim: Misato spent several years completely mute and institutionalized following the Second Impact catastrophe.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Witnessing the catastrophic explosion in Antarctica and seeing her father sacrifice his life to seal her in a capsule caused severe psychological trauma that rendered her speechless throughout adolescence.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: She is an atrocious home cook who routinely serves canned retort curry and instant noodles mixed with beer.

facts_and_myths.claim: Misato was aware from the very beginning of NERV's secret true agenda to trigger the Human Instrumentality Project.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Misato genuinely believed NERV was fighting solely to protect humanity from extinction by the Angels, only uncovering Gendo Ikari and SEELE's apocalyptic secret plans through dangerous rogue investigations with Ryoji Kaji.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: Her signature car is a customized electric-converted Renault Alpine A310 sports coupe.

name: Batou
visual_anchor: Gritty cyberpunk vertical 9:16 visual of cyborg operative Batou aiming a heavy automatic shotgun in a rainy neon-lit alleyway, distinctive circular prosthetic eye implants glowing faint amber, brawny build in a heavy leather duster, rain dripping from his slicked-back grey crew cut.
core_traits: Heavily augmented cybernetic operative and trusted field second-in-command of Public Security Section 9 under Major Motoko Kusanagi
Former military ranger whose signature features include cylindrical prosthetic ocular implants and immense cybernetic brawn
Develops a deeply affectionate, protective bond with Section 9's artificial intelligence spider-tanks, the Tachikomas
Harbors quiet, unspoken romantic and philosophical loyalty toward Major Kusanagi across various cybernetic investigations

facts_and_myths.claim: Batou is a full cyborg whose brain and consciousness have been completely replaced with synthetic neural AI.
facts_and_myths.explanation: Batou possesses a biological human brain housed in a titanium casing with a cyberbrain interface, retaining his original human ghost and consciousness despite nearly his entire body being replaced with prosthetic cybernetics.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: He is fiercely dedicated to weightlifting with physical barbells despite his cybernetic body meaning natural muscles cannot grow.

facts_and_myths.claim: Batou regularly gives unapproved natural oil to his assigned Tachikoma spider-tank, accidentally accelerating its developing sentience.
facts_and_myths.explanation: His habit of treating his personal Tachikoma with affection and lubricating it with real natural oil rather than synthetic lubricants helps trigger the tank's philosophical self-awareness and individuality.
facts_and_myths.fun_fact: In his private apartment, Batou lives with and dotes on a cloned basset hound named Gabriel.
